versions.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

versions.niv: If you love me, keep my commands.

versions.asv: fear thou not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
versions.csb: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will help you; I will hold on to you with my righteous right hand.
versions.esv: fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
versions.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
versions.nasb: ‘Do not fear, for I am with you; Do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, I will also help you, I will also uphold you with My righteous right hand.’
versions.niv: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

versions.web: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

versions.csb: Jesus answered him, "What I’m doing you don’t realize now, but afterward you will understand.
versions.esv: Jesus answered him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but afterward you will understand.

versions.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will know after this.
versions.web: Jesus answered him, "You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.

versions.nkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits:

versions.nkjv: Commit your works to the Lord, And your thoughts will be established.
versions.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

versions.asv: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.
versions.csb: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but one of power,, love, and sound judgment.

versions.niv: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.
versions.nkjv: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.
versions.web: For God didn’ t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

versions.asv: And be not fashioned according to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
versions.csb: Do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may discern what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
versions.esv: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind, that by testing you may discern what is the will of God, what is good and acceptable and perfect.
versions.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
versions.nasb: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect.
versions.niv: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.
versions.nkjv: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
versions.web: Don’ t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

versions.asv: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
versions.csb: What, then, are we to say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
versions.esv: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
versions.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
versions.nasb: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
versions.niv: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
versions.nkjv: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who canbe against us?

versions.nkjv: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

versions.csb: but those who trust in the Lord will renew their strength; they will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not become weary, they will walk and not faint.
versions.esv: but they who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint.
versions.kjv: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

versions.nkjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, And He delights in his way.
versions.web: A man ’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

versions.csb: A thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come so that they may have life and have it in abundance.
versions.esv: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life and have it abundantly.
versions.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
versions.nasb: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I came so that they would have life, and have it abundantly.

versions.nkjv: The thief does not come except to steal, and to kill, and to destroy. I have come that they may have life, and that they may have it more abundantly.
versions.web: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

versions.esv: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

versions.nkjv: Draw near to God and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

versions.asv: And Jesus said unto him, If thou canst! All things are possible to him that believeth.

versions.nkjv: Jesus said to him, "If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.
versions.web: Jesus said to him, "If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.

versions.asv: Enter ye in by the narrow gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many are they that enter in thereby. For narrow is the gate, and straitened the way, that leadeth unto life, and few are they that find it.
versions.csb: Enter through the narrow gate. For the gate is wide and the road broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who go through it. How narrow is the gate and difficult the road that leads to life, and few find it.
versions.esv: Enter by the narrow gate. For the gate is wide and the way is easy that leads to destruction, and those who enter by it are many. For the gate is narrow and the way is hard that leads to life, and those who find it are few.
versions.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
versions.nasb: Enter through the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter through it. For the gate is narrow and the way is constricted that leads to life, and there are few who find it.
versions.niv: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it. But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.
versions.nkjv: Enter by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and there are many who go in by it. Because narrow is the gate and difficult is the way which leads to life, and there are few who find it.
versions.web: Enter in by the narrow gate ; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it. How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life ! There are few who find it.

versions.asv: (for we walk by faith, not by sight);

versions.asv: And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life? And why are ye anxious concerning raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: yet I say unto you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. But if God doth so clothe the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
versions.csb: Can any of you add one moment to his life span by worrying? And why do you worry about clothes? Observe how the wildflowers of the field grow: They don’t labor or spin thread. Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was adorned like one of these. If that’s how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and thrown into the furnace tomorrow, won’t he do much more for you — you of little faith?
versions.esv: And which of you by being anxious can add a single hour to his span of life? And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin, yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is alive and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
versions.nasb: And which of you by worrying can add a single day to his life’s span? And why are you worried about clothing? Notice how the lilies of the field grow; they do not labor nor do they spin thread for cloth, yet I say to you that not even Solomon in all his glory clothed himself like one of these. But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you? You of little faith!
versions.niv: Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life ? "And why do you worry about clothes? See how the flowers of the field grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these. If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, will he not much more clothe you—you of little faith?
versions.nkjv: Which of you by worrying can add one cubit to his stature? "So why do you worry about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; and yet I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. Now if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
versions.web: Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan? Why are you anxious about clothing ? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’ t toil, neither do they spin, yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these. But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’ t he much more clothe you, you of little faith ?

versions.csb: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Don’t let your heart be troubled or fearful.
versions.esv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.
versions.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
versions.nasb: Peace I leave you, My peace I give you; not as the world gives, do I give to you. Do not let your hearts be troubled, nor fearful.
versions.niv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.
versions.nkjv: Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
versions.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you ; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’ t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

versions.csb: A good name is to be chosen over great wealth; favor is better than silver and gold.
versions.esv: A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches, and favor is better than silver or gold.
versions.kjv: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
versions.nasb: A good name is to be more desired than great wealth; Favor is better than silver and gold.
versions.niv: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.
versions.nkjv: A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches, Loving favor rather than silver and gold.
versions.web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

versions.asv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding your own selves.

versions.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

versions.asv: Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than the food, and the body than the raiment?
versions.csb: Therefore I tell you: Don’t worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food and the body more than clothing?
versions.esv: Therefore I tell you, do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink, nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
versions.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
versions.nasb: For this reason I say to you, do not be worried about your life, as to what you will eat or what you will drink; nor for your body, as to what you will put on. Is life not more than food, and the body more than clothing?
versions.niv: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
versions.nkjv: Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food and the body more than clothing?
versions.web: Therefore I tell you, don’ t be anxious for your life : what you will eat, or what you will drink ; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’ t life more than food, and the body more than clothing ?

versions.asv: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
versions.csb: There is no fear in love; instead, perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. So the one who fears is not complete in love.
versions.esv: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear. For fear has to do with punishment, and whoever fears has not been perfected in love.
versions.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
versions.nasb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment, and the one who fears is not perfected in love.
versions.niv: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.
versions.nkjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear involves torment. But he who fears has not been made perfect in love.
versions.web: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

versions.asv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
versions.csb: Don’t be deceived: God is not mocked. For whatever a person sows he will also reap,
versions.esv: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap.
versions.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
versions.nasb: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a person sows, this he will also reap.
versions.niv: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.
versions.nkjv: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
versions.web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

versions.asv: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
versions.csb: You reveal the path of life to me; in your presence is abundant joy; at your right hand are eternal pleasures.
versions.esv: You make known to me the path of life; in your presence there is fullness of joy; at your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
versions.kjv: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
versions.nasb: You will make known to me the way of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; In Your right hand there are pleasures forever.
versions.niv: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.
versions.nkjv: You will show me the path of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; At Your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
versions.web: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

versions.asv: And when ye pray, ye shall not be as the hypocrites: for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward. But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee. And in praying use not vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
versions.csb: Whenever you pray, you must not be like the hypocrites, because they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by people. Truly I tell you, they have their reward. But when you pray, go into your private room, shut your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you., When you pray, don’t babble like the Gentiles, since they imagine they’ll be heard for their many words.
versions.esv: And when you pray, you must not be like the hypocrites. For they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and at the street corners, that they may be seen by others. Truly, I say to you, they have received their reward. But when you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you. "And when you pray, do not heap up empty phrases as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard for their many words.
versions.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward. But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly. But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
versions.nasb: And when you pray, you are not to be like the hypocrites; for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners so that they will be seen by people. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full. But as for you, when you pray, go into your inner room, close your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you. "And when you are praying, do not use thoughtless repetition as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard because of their many words.
versions.niv: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full. But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you. And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words.
versions.nkjv: And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward. But you, when you pray, go into your room, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father who is in the secret place; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly. And when you pray, do not use vain repetitions as the heathen do. For they think that they will be heard for their many words.
versions.web: When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward. But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret ; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly. In praying, don’ t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do ; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

versions.asv: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.
versions.csb: Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is very powerful in its effect.
versions.esv: Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person has great power as it is working.
versions.kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
versions.nasb: Therefore, confess your sins to one another, and pray for one another so that you may be healed. A prayer of a righteous person, when it is brought about, can accomplish much.
versions.niv: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.
versions.nkjv: Confess your trespasses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The effective, fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.
versions.web: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

versions.nkjv: For You will light my lamp; The Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.

versions.asv: but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace have ye been saved), and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places, in Christ Jesus: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus: for by grace have ye been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God; not of works, that no man should glory. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
versions.csb: But God, who is rich in mercy, because of his great love that he had for us, made us alive with Christ even though we were dead in trespasses. You are saved by grace! He also raised us up with him and seated us with him in the heavens in Christ Jesus, so that in the coming ages he might display the immeasurable riches of his grace through his kindness to us in Christ Jesus. For you are saved by grace through faith, and this is not from yourselves; it is God’s gift — not from works, so that no one can boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared ahead of time for us to do.
versions.esv: But God, being rich in mercy, because of the great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead in our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ— by grace you have been saved— and raised us up with him and seated us with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus, so that in the coming ages he might show the immeasurable riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus. For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God, not a result of works, so that no one may boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.

For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
versions.nasb: But God, being rich in mercy, because of His great love with which He loved us, even when we were dead in our wrongdoings, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved), and raised us up with Him, and seated us with Him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus, so that in the ages to come He might show the boundless riches of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus. For by grace you have been saved through faith; and this is not of yourselves, it is the gift of God; not a result of works, so that no one may boast. For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand so that we would walk in them.

For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God— not by works, so that no one can boast. For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; itis the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast. For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.

For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

versions.nasb: For the Lord loves justice And does not abandon His godly ones; They are protected forever, But the descendants of the wicked will be eliminated.
versions.niv: For the Lord loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed ; the offspring of the wicked will perish.

versions.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
versions.nasb: I will give thanks to You, because I am awesomely and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Your works, And my soul knows it very well.
versions.niv: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

versions.csb: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, because I am lowly and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

versions.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

versions.niv: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.nkjv: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.web: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart ; and you will find rest for your souls.

versions.asv: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

versions.esv: On God rests my salvation and my glory; my mighty rock, my refuge is God.
versions.kjv: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
versions.nasb: My salvation and my glory rest on God; The rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.
versions.niv: My salvation and my honor depend on God ; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.
versions.nkjv: In God is my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, And my refuge, is in God.
versions.web: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

versions.asv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.
versions.csb: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in me and I in him produces much fruit, because you can do nothing without me.
versions.esv: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
versions.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
versions.nasb: I am the vine, you are the branches; the one who remains in Me, and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from Me you can do nothing.
versions.niv: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.
versions.nkjv: I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.
versions.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

versions.asv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in Jehovah, and whose trust Jehovah is.
versions.csb: The person who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence indeed is the Lord, is blessed.
versions.esv: Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, whose trust is the Lord.

versions.nkjv: Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, And whose hope is the Lord.
versions.web: Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.

versions.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

versions.niv: In his name the nations will put their hope.
versions.nkjv: And in His name Gentiles will trust.
versions.web: In his name, the nations will hope.

versions.asv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
versions.csb: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared ahead of time for us to do.
versions.esv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.
versions.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
versions.nasb: For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand so that we would walk in them.
versions.niv: For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
versions.nkjv: For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.
versions.web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

versions.asv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
versions.csb: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable to you, Lord, my rock and my Redeemer.
versions.esv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, O Lord, my rock and my redeemer.

versions.web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

versions.asv: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.

versions.asv: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.
versions.csb: Arrogance leads to nothing but strife, but wisdom is gained by those who take advice.
versions.esv: By insolence comes nothing but strife, but with those who take advice is wisdom.

versions.nkjv: By pride comes nothing but strife, But with the well-advised is wisdom.

versions.asv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
versions.csb: If we say, "We have no sin," we are deceiving ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

versions.nkjv: Let no one despise your youth, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

versions.nkjv: Every valley shall be filled And every mountain and hill brought low; The crooked places shall be made straight And the rough ways smooth;

versions.nkjv: For where two or three are gathered together in My name, I am there in the midst of them.
versions.web: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.

versions.nasb: A wise man is strong, And a person of knowledge increases power.

versions.nkjv: A wise man is strong, Yes, a man of knowledge increases strength;

versions.asv: For David saith concerning him, I beheld the Lord always before my face; For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
versions.csb: For David says of him: I saw the Lord ever before me; because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
versions.esv: For David says concerning him, "‘I saw the Lord always before me, for he is at my right hand that I may not be shaken;
versions.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
versions.nasb: For David says of Him, ‘I saw the Lord continually before me, Because He is at my right hand, so that I will not be shaken.
versions.niv: David said about him: "‘I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

versions.web: For David says concerning him, ‘ I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

versions.asv: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
versions.csb: With your hand, Lord, save me from men, from men of the world whose portion is in this life: You fill their bellies with what you have in store; their sons are satisfied, and they leave their surplus to their children.
versions.esv: from men by your hand, O Lord, from men of the world whose portion is in this life. You fill their womb with treasure; they are satisfied with children, and they leave their abundance to their infants.
versions.kjv: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
versions.nasb: From people by Your hand, Lord, From people of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly You fill with Your treasure; They are satisfied with children, And leave their abundance to their babies.
versions.niv: By your hand save me from such people, Lord, from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.
versions.nkjv: With Your hand from men, O Lord, From men of the world whohave their portion in this life, And whose belly You fill with Your hidden treasure. They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their possession for their babes.
versions.web: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

versions.nkjv: Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, And before honor is humility.

versions.asv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

versions.esv: For I am sure that neither death nor life, nor angels nor rulers, nor things present nor things to come, nor powers, nor height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

versions.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

versions.esv: He has told you, O man, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?

versions.nkjv: The fear of the Lordis the instruction of wisdom, And before honor is humility.

versions.nkjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake you; Bind them around your neck, Write them on the tablet of your heart,

versions.esv: do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
versions.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
versions.nasb: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and pleading with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all comprehension, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.

versions.nkjv: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

versions.niv: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.
versions.nkjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

versions.csb: I lift my eyes toward the mountains. Where will my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

versions.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
versions.nasb: I will raise my eyes to the mountains; From where will my help come? My help comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
versions.niv: I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.
versions.nkjv: I will lift up my eyes to the hills— From whence comes my help? My help comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.

versions.nkjv: So teach us to number our days, That we may gain a heart of wisdom.

versions.csb: So we do not focus on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
versions.esv: as we look not to the things that are seen but to the things that are unseen. For the things that are seen are transient, but the things that are unseen are eternal.

versions.web: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

versions.asv: Love suffereth long, and is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not its own, is not provoked, taketh not account of evil; rejoiceth not in unrighteousness, but rejoiceth with the truth; beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things. Love never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall be done away; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall be done away.
versions.csb: Love is patient, love is kind. Love does not envy, is not boastful, is not arrogant, is not rude, is not self-seeking, is not irritable, and does not keep a record of wrongs. Love finds no joy in unrighteousness but rejoices in the truth. It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never ends. But as for prophecies, they will come to an end; as for tongues, they will cease; as for knowledge, it will come to an end.
versions.esv: Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful; it does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth. Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never ends. As for prophecies, they will pass away; as for tongues, they will cease; as for knowledge, it will pass away.
versions.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil; Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth; Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things. Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
versions.nasb: Love is patient, love is kind, it is not jealous; love does not brag, it is not arrogant. It does not act disgracefully, it does not seek its own benefit; it is not provoked, does not keep an account of a wrong suffered, it does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth; it keeps every confidence, it believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails; but if there are gifts of prophecy, they will be done away with; if there are tongues, they will cease; if there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
versions.niv: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres. Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.
versions.nkjv: Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails. But whether thereare prophecies, they will fail; whether thereare tongues, they will cease; whether thereis knowledge, it will vanish away.
versions.web: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’ t envy. Love doesn’ t brag, is not proud, doesn’ t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’ t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil ; doesn’ t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things. Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

versions.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
versions.nasb: Never take your own revenge, beloved, but leave room for the wrath of God, for it is written: "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay," says the Lord.
versions.niv: Do not take revenge, my dear friends, but leave room for God’s wrath, for it is written: "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," says the Lord.
versions.nkjv: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but rather give place to wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay," says the Lord.
versions.web: Don’ t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God ’ s wrath. For it is written, "Vengeance belongs to me ; I will repay, says the Lord.

versions.asv: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and such we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
versions.csb: See what great love the Father has given us that we should be called God’s children — and we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it didn’t know him.
versions.esv: See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God; and so we are. The reason why the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
versions.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
versions.nasb: See how great a love the Father has given us, that we would be called children of God; and in fact we are. For this reason the world does not know us: because it did not know Him.
versions.niv: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
versions.nkjv: Behold what manner of love the Father has bestowed on us, that we should be called children of God! Therefore the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.
versions.web: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God ! For this cause the world doesn’ t know us, because it didn’ t know him.

versions.asv: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
versions.csb: Be on your guard against false prophets who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravaging wolves.
versions.esv: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
versions.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
versions.nasb: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
versions.niv: Watch out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ferocious wolves.
versions.nkjv: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
versions.web: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep ’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

versions.asv: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places.
versions.csb: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers of this darkness, against evil, spiritual forces in the heavens.
versions.esv: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places.
versions.kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
versions.nasb: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the powers, against the world forces of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
versions.niv: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
versions.nkjv: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places.
versions.web: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world ’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

versions.asv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
versions.csb: Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
versions.esv: Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
versions.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
versions.nasb: Do not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
versions.niv: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.
versions.nkjv: Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
versions.web: Don’ t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father ’s love isn’ t in him.

versions.asv: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only use not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.
versions.csb: For you were called to be free, brothers and sisters; only don’t use this freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but serve one another through love.
versions.esv: For you were called to freedom, brothers. Only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.
versions.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
versions.nasb: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters; only do not turn your freedom into an opportunity for the flesh, but serve one another through love.
versions.niv: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh ; rather, serve one another humbly in love.
versions.nkjv: For you, brethren, have been called to liberty; only do not use liberty as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.
versions.web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’ t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

versions.asv: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
versions.csb: But you are a chosen race,,, a royal priesthood,, a holy nation,, a people for his possession,, so that you may proclaim the praises,, of the one who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
versions.esv: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession, that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
versions.kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
versions.nasb: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people forGod’s own possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;
versions.niv: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.
versions.nkjv: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;
versions.web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God ’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

versions.asv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.csb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.esv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.nasb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.niv: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.nkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

versions.asv: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.
versions.csb: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
versions.esv: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever utters slander is a fool.
versions.kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
versions.nasb: One who conceals hatred has lying lips, And one who spreads slander is a fool.
versions.niv: Whoever conceals hatred with lying lips and spreads slander is a fool.
versions.nkjv: Whoever hides hatred has lying lips, And whoever spreads slander is a fool.
versions.web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

versions.asv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.csb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

versions.nkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

versions.asv: Look therefore carefully how ye walk, not as unwise, but as wise;
versions.csb: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk — not as unwise people but as wise —
versions.esv: Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
versions.kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
versions.nasb: So then, be careful how you walk, not as unwise people but as wise,
versions.niv: Be very careful, then, how you live—not as unwise but as wise,
versions.nkjv: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools but as wise,
versions.web: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

versions.asv: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.
versions.csb: This is eternal life: that they may know you, the only true God, and the one you have sent — Jesus Christ.
versions.esv: And this is eternal life, that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.
versions.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
versions.nasb: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.
versions.niv: Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
versions.nkjv: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.
versions.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

versions.asv: He that followeth after righteousness and kindness Findeth life, righteousness, and honor.
versions.csb: The one who pursues righteousness and faithful love will find life, righteousness, and honor.
versions.esv: Whoever pursues righteousness and kindness will find life, righteousness, and honor.
versions.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
versions.nasb: One who pursues righteousness and loyalty Finds life, righteousness, and honor.
versions.niv: Whoever pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.
versions.nkjv: He who follows righteousness and mercy Finds life, righteousness, and honor.
versions.web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

versions.asv: I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
versions.csb: I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.
versions.esv: I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
versions.kjv: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
versions.nasb: I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
versions.niv: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.
versions.nkjv: I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
versions.web: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

versions.asv: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.
versions.csb: A slacker’s way is like a thorny hedge, but the path of the upright is a highway.
versions.esv: The way of a sluggard is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a level highway.
versions.kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
versions.nasb: The way of the lazy one is like a hedge of thorns, But the path of the upright is a highway.
versions.niv: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
versions.nkjv: The way of the lazy manis like a hedge of thorns, But the way of the upright is a highway.
versions.web: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

versions.asv: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
versions.csb: giving thanks always for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
versions.esv: giving thanks always and for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
versions.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
versions.nasb: always giving thanks for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to our God and Father;

versions.nkjv: giving thanks always for all things to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,

versions.niv: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
versions.nkjv: Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, For theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
versions.web: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness ’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

versions.asv: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.
versions.csb: The Lord ’s blessing enriches, and he adds no painful effort to it.,
versions.esv: The blessing of the Lord makes rich, and he adds no sorrow with it.
versions.kjv: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
versions.nasb: It is the blessing of the Lord that makes rich, And He adds no sorrow to it.
versions.niv: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.
versions.nkjv: The blessing of the Lord makes one rich, And He adds no sorrow with it.
versions.web: Yahweh ’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

versions.asv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
versions.csb: Solomon’s proverbs: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son, heartache to his mother.
versions.esv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son is a sorrow to his mother.
versions.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
versions.nasb: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish son is a grief to his mother.
versions.niv: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
versions.nkjv: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes a glad father, But a foolish son is the grief of his mother.
versions.web: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father ; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

versions.asv: but thanks be to God, who giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.csb: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
versions.esv: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.nasb: but thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.niv: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.nkjv: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
versions.web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

versions.asv: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
versions.csb: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord — the people he has chosen to be his own possession!
versions.esv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people whom he has chosen as his heritage!
versions.kjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
versions.nasb: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, The people He has chosen for His own inheritance.
versions.niv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people he chose for his inheritance.
versions.nkjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, The people He has chosen as His own inheritance.
versions.web: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

versions.asv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
versions.csb: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise. Give thanks to him and bless his name.
versions.esv: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name!
versions.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
versions.nasb: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, And His courtyards with praise. Give thanks to Him, bless His name.
versions.niv: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
versions.nkjv: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Be thankful to Him, and bless His name.
versions.web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

versions.asv: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
versions.csb: So it is sin to know the good and yet not do it.
versions.esv: So whoever knows the right thing to do and fails to do it, for him it is sin.
versions.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
versions.nasb: So for one who knows the right thing to do and does not do it, for him it is sin.
versions.niv: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.
versions.nkjv: Therefore, to him who knows to do good and does not do it, to him it is sin.
versions.web: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

versions.asv: Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
versions.csb: Come to me, all of you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, because I am lowly and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.
versions.esv: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
versions.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
versions.nasb: Come to Me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is comfortable, and My burden is light.
versions.niv: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.
versions.nkjv: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.
versions.web: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart ; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

versions.asv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.
versions.csb: They are more desirable than gold — than an abundance of pure gold; and sweeter than honey dripping from a honeycomb.
versions.esv: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb.
versions.kjv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
versions.nasb: They are more desirable than gold, yes, than much pure gold; Sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb.
versions.niv: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.
versions.nkjv: More to be desired arethey than gold, Yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
versions.web: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

versions.asv: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee, and will keep watch.
versions.csb: In the morning, Lord, you hear my voice; in the morning I plead my case to you and watch expectantly.
versions.esv: O Lord, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and watch.
versions.kjv: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD ; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
versions.nasb: In the morning, Lord, You will hear my voice; In the morning I will present my prayer to You and be on the watch.
versions.niv: In the morning, Lord, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly.
versions.nkjv: My voice You shall hear in the morning, O Lord; In the morning I will direct it to You, And I will look up.
versions.web: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

versions.asv: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
versions.csb: For the Lord God is a sun and shield. The Lord grants favor and honor; he does not withhold the good from those who live with integrity.
versions.esv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor. No good thing does he withhold from those who walk uprightly.
versions.kjv: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
versions.nasb: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; The Lord gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
versions.niv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.
versions.nkjv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; The Lord will give grace and glory; No good thing will He withhold From those who walk uprightly.
versions.web: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

versions.asv: Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace among men in whom he is well pleased.
versions.csb: Glory to God in the highest heaven, and peace on earth to people he favors!,,
versions.esv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those with whom he is pleased!
versions.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
versions.nasb: Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace among people with whom He is pleased.
versions.niv: Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests.
versions.nkjv: Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace, goodwill toward men!
versions.web: Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.

versions.csb: so that you may walk worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him: bearing fruit in every good work and growing in the knowledge of God,
versions.esv: so as to walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him: bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God;
versions.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
versions.nasb: so that you will walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, to please Him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God;
versions.niv: so that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

versions.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
