versions.asv: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
versions.csb: The Lord is near all who call out to him, all who call out to him with integrity.
versions.esv: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
versions.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
versions.nasb: The Lord is near to all who call on Him, To all who call on Him in truth.
versions.niv: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
versions.nkjv: The Lordis near to all who call upon Him, To all who call upon Him in truth.
versions.web: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

versions.asv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
versions.csb: Call on me in a day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
versions.esv: and call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.
versions.kjv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
versions.nasb: Call upon Me on the day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you will honor Me.
versions.niv: and call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me.
versions.nkjv: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me.
versions.web: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.

versions.asv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
versions.csb: I call on you, God, because you will answer me; listen closely to me; hear what I say.
versions.esv: I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God; incline your ear to me; hear my words.
versions.kjv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
versions.nasb: I have called upon You, for You will answer me, God; Incline Your ear to me, hear my speech.
versions.niv: I call on you, my God, for you will answer me; turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.
versions.nkjv: I have called upon You, for You will hear me, O God; Incline Your ear to me, and hear my speech.
versions.web: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

versions.asv: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
versions.csb: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own. However, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of it, the world hates you.
versions.esv: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
versions.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
versions.nasb: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, because of this the world hates you.
versions.niv: If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.
versions.nkjv: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. Yet because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
versions.web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

versions.asv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
versions.csb: Love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the atoning sacrifice, for our sins.
versions.esv: In this is love, not that we have loved God but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
versions.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
versions.nasb: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
versions.niv: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.
versions.nkjv: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son tobe the propitiation for our sins.
versions.web: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

versions.asv: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
versions.csb: For he will give his angels orders concerning you, to protect you in all your ways.
versions.esv: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
versions.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
versions.nasb: For He will give His angels orders concerning you, To protect you in all your ways.
versions.niv: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
versions.nkjv: For He shall give His angels charge over you, To keep you in all your ways.
versions.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

versions.asv: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.
versions.csb: Be diligent to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who doesn’t need to be ashamed, correctly teaching the word of truth.
versions.esv: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
versions.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
versions.nasb: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God as a worker who does not need to be ashamed, accurately handling the word of truth.
versions.niv: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.
versions.nkjv: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a worker who does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
versions.web: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’ t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

versions.asv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,
versions.csb: You rejoice in this, even though now for a short time, if necessary, you suffer grief in various trials
versions.esv: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,
versions.kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
versions.nasb: In this you greatly rejoice, even though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been distressed by various trials,
versions.niv: In all this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.
versions.nkjv: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved by various trials,
versions.web: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

versions.asv: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.
versions.csb: For the Lord is righteous; he loves righteous deeds. The upright will see his face.
versions.esv: For the Lord is righteous; he loves righteous deeds; the upright shall behold his face.
versions.kjv: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
versions.nasb: For the Lord is righteous, He loves righteousness; The upright will see His face.
versions.niv: For the Lord is righteous, he loves justice; the upright will see his face.
versions.nkjv: For the Lordis righteous, He loves righteousness; His countenance beholds the upright.
versions.web: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

versions.asv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
versions.csb: And the world with its lust is passing away, but the one who does the will of God remains forever.
versions.esv: And the world is passing away along with its desires, but whoever does the will of God abides forever.
versions.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
versions.nasb: The world is passing away and also its lusts; but the one who does the will of God continues to live forever.
versions.niv: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.
versions.nkjv: And the world is passing away, and the lust of it; but he who does the will of God abides forever.
versions.web: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God ’s will remains forever.

versions.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth hath eternal life.
versions.csb: Truly I tell you, anyone who believes has eternal life.
versions.esv: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes has eternal life.
versions.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
versions.nasb: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who believes has eternal life.
versions.niv: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.
versions.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me has everlasting life.
versions.web: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

versions.asv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
versions.csb: Blessed are the humble, for they will inherit the earth.
versions.esv: Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
versions.kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
versions.nasb: Blessed are the gentle, for they will inherit the earth.
versions.niv: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
versions.nkjv: Blessed are the meek, For they shall inherit the earth.
versions.web: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

versions.asv: And God is able to make all grace abound unto you; that ye, having always all sufficiency in everything, may abound unto every good work:
versions.csb: And God is able to make every grace overflow to you, so that in every way, always having everything you need, you may excel in every good work.
versions.esv: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in all things at all times, you may abound in every good work.
versions.kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
versions.nasb: And God is able to make all grace overflow to you, so that, always having all sufficiency in everything, you may have an abundance for every good deed;
versions.niv: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
versions.nkjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you, that you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may have an abundance for every good work.
versions.web: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

versions.asv: Know ye not that ye are a temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
versions.csb: Don’t you yourselves know that you are God’s temple and that the Spirit of God lives in you?
versions.esv: Do you not know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
versions.kjv: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
versions.nasb: Do you not know that you are a temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?
versions.niv: Don’t you know that you yourselves are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in your midst?
versions.nkjv: Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?
versions.web: Don’ t you know that you are God ’s temple and that God ’s Spirit lives in you ?

versions.asv: But the Comforter, even the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.
versions.csb: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and remind you of everything I have told you.
versions.esv: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you.
versions.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
versions.nasb: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and remind you of all that I said to you.
versions.niv: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.
versions.nkjv: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all things that I said to you.
versions.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

versions.asv: And the Lord’s servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,
versions.csb: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but must be gentle to everyone, able to teach, and patient,
versions.esv: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but kind to everyone, able to teach, patiently enduring evil,
versions.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
versions.nasb: The Lord’s bond-servant must not be quarrelsome, but be kind to all, skillful in teaching, patient when wronged,
versions.niv: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.
versions.nkjv: And a servant of the Lord must not quarrel but be gentle to all, able to teach, patient,
versions.web: The Lord ’ s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

versions.asv: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.
versions.csb: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and great in faithful love.
versions.esv: The Lord is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
versions.kjv: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
versions.nasb: The Lord is gracious and compassionate; Slow to anger and great in mercy.
versions.niv: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.
versions.nkjv: The Lordis gracious and full of compassion, Slow to anger and great in mercy.
versions.web: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

versions.asv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.
versions.csb: The fool says in his heart, "There’s no God." They are corrupt; they do vile deeds. There is no one who does good.
versions.esv: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, they do abominable deeds; there is none who does good.
versions.kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
versions.nasb: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, they have committed detestable acts; There is no one who does good.
versions.niv: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.
versions.nkjv: The fool has said in his heart, "Thereis no God." They are corrupt, They have done abominable works, There is none who does good.
versions.web: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

versions.asv: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
versions.csb: He is not here. For he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
versions.esv: He is not here, for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.
versions.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
versions.nasb: He is not here, for He has risen, just as He said. Come, see the place where He was lying.
versions.niv: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
versions.nkjv: He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
versions.web: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

versions.asv: and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your hands, even as we charged you;
versions.csb: to seek to lead a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
versions.esv: and to aspire to live quietly, and to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands, as we instructed you,
versions.kjv: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
versions.nasb: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life and attend to your own business and work with your hands, just as we instructed you,
versions.niv: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,
versions.nkjv: that you also aspire to lead a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
versions.web: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

versions.asv: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.
versions.csb: and that is why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that he is able to guard what has been entrusted to me, until that day.
versions.esv: which is why I suffer as I do. But I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard until that day what has been entrusted to me.
versions.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
versions.nasb: For this reason I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to protect what I have entrusted to Him until that day.
versions.niv: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet this is no cause for shame, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.
versions.nkjv: For this reason I also suffer these things; nevertheless I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able to keep what I have committed to Him until that Day.
versions.web: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

versions.asv: But go ye and learn what this meaneth, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice: for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
versions.csb: Go and learn what this means: I desire mercy and not sacrifice., For I didn’t come to call the righteous, but sinners.
versions.esv: Go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice.’ For I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
versions.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
versions.nasb: Now go and learn what this means: ‘I desire compassion, rather than sacrifice,’ for I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
versions.niv: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
versions.nkjv: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy and not sacrifice.’ For I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.
versions.web: But you go and learn what this means : ‘ I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

versions.asv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
versions.csb: But when you pray, go into your private room, shut your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.,
versions.esv: But when you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
versions.kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
versions.nasb: But as for you, when you pray, go into your inner room, close your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.
versions.niv: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
versions.nkjv: But you, when you pray, go into your room, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father who is in the secret place; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
versions.web: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret ; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

versions.asv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, these shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.
versions.csb: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth. For he will not speak on his own, but he will speak whatever he hears. He will also declare to you what is to come.
versions.esv: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth, for he will not speak on his own authority, but whatever he hears he will speak, and he will declare to you the things that are to come.
versions.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
versions.nasb: But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will guide you into all the truth; for He will not speak on His own, but whatever He hears, He will speak; and He will disclose to you what is to come.
versions.niv: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.
versions.nkjv: However, when He, the Spirit of truth, has come, He will guide you into all truth; for He will not speak on His own authority, but whatever He hears He will speak; and He will tell you things to come.
versions.web: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself ; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

versions.asv: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. For with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
versions.csb: Give, and it will be given to you; a good measure — pressed down, shaken together, and running over — will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.
versions.esv: give, and it will be given to you. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, will be put into your lap. For with the measure you use it will be measured back to you.
versions.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
versions.nasb: Give, and it will be given to you. They will pour into your lap a good measure—pressed down, shaken together, and running over. For by your standard of measure it will be measured to you in return.
versions.niv: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
versions.nkjv: Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be put into your bosom. For with the same measure that you use, it will be measured back to you.
versions.web: Give, and it will be given to you : good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.

versions.asv: The foolishness of man subverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against Jehovah.
versions.csb: A person’s own foolishness leads him astray, yet his heart rages against the Lord.
versions.esv: When a man’s folly brings his way to ruin, his heart rages against the Lord.
versions.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
versions.nasb: The foolishness of a person ruins his way, And his heart rages against the Lord.
versions.niv: A person’s own folly leads to their ruin, yet their heart rages against the Lord.
versions.nkjv: The foolishness of a man twists his way, And his heart frets against the Lord.
versions.web: The foolishness of man subverts his way ; his heart rages against Yahweh.

versions.asv: Be not therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
versions.csb: Don’t be like them, because your Father knows the things you need before you ask him.
versions.esv: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
versions.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
versions.nasb: So do not be like them; for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
versions.niv: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
versions.nkjv: Therefore do not be like them. For your Father knows the things you have need of before you ask Him.
versions.web: Therefore don’ t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

versions.asv: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.
versions.csb: This is what I command you: Love one another.
versions.esv: These things I command you, so that you will love one another.
versions.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
versions.nasb: This I command you, that you love one another.
versions.niv: This is my command: Love each other.
versions.nkjv: These things I command you, that you love one another.
versions.web: I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

versions.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God; and they that hear shall live.
versions.csb: Truly I tell you, an hour is coming, and is now here, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
versions.esv: Truly, truly, I say to you, an hour is coming, and is now here, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
versions.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
versions.nasb: Truly, truly, I say to you, a time is coming and even now has arrived, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
versions.niv: Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.
versions.nkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes in Him who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life.
versions.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’ t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

versions.asv: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.
versions.csb: All humanity will come to you, the one who hears prayer.
versions.esv: O you who hear prayer, to you shall all flesh come.
versions.kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
versions.nasb: You who hear prayer, To You all mankind comes.
versions.niv: You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.
versions.nkjv: O You who hear prayer, To You all flesh will come.
versions.web: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

versions.asv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, And obtaineth favor of Jehovah.
versions.csb: A man who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the Lord.
versions.esv: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the Lord.
versions.kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
versions.nasb: He who finds a wife finds a good thing And obtains favor from the Lord.
versions.niv: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord.
versions.nkjv: Hewho finds a wife finds a good thing, And obtains favor from the Lord.
versions.web: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

versions.asv: The heart is deceitful above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who can know it?
versions.csb: The heart is more deceitful than anything else, and incurable — who can understand it?
versions.esv: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick; who can understand it?
versions.kjv: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
versions.nasb: The heart is more deceitful than all else And is desperately sick; Who can understand it?
versions.niv: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
versions.nkjv: The heart is deceitful above all things, And desperately wicked; Who can know it?
versions.web: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it ?

versions.asv: Love suffereth long, and is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not its own, is not provoked, taketh not account of evil; rejoiceth not in unrighteousness, but rejoiceth with the truth; beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
versions.csb: Love is patient, love is kind. Love does not envy, is not boastful, is not arrogant, is not rude, is not self-seeking, is not irritable, and does not keep a record of wrongs. Love finds no joy in unrighteousness but rejoices in the truth. It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
versions.esv: Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful; it does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth. Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
versions.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil; Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth; Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
versions.nasb: Love is patient, love is kind, it is not jealous; love does not brag, it is not arrogant. It does not act disgracefully, it does not seek its own benefit; it is not provoked, does not keep an account of a wrong suffered, it does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth; it keeps every confidence, it believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
versions.niv: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.
versions.nkjv: Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
versions.web: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’ t envy. Love doesn’ t brag, is not proud, doesn’ t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’ t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil ; doesn’ t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

versions.asv: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
versions.csb: There is profit in all hard work, but endless talk leads only to poverty.
versions.esv: In all toil there is profit, but mere talk tends only to poverty.
versions.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
versions.nasb: In all labor there is profit, But mere talk leads only to poverty.
versions.niv: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
versions.nkjv: In all labor there is profit, But idle chatter leads only to poverty.
versions.web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

versions.asv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore the scripture saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
versions.csb: But he gives greater grace. Therefore he says: God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble.,
versions.esv: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.
versions.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
versions.nasb: But He gives a greater grace. Therefore it says, "God is opposed to the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
versions.niv: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: "God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.
versions.nkjv: But He gives more grace. Therefore He says: "God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble.
versions.web: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, "God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

versions.asv: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.
versions.csb: The wicked person earns an empty wage, but the one who sows righteousness, a true reward.
versions.esv: The wicked earns deceptive wages, but one who sows righteousness gets a sure reward.
versions.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
versions.nasb: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, But one who sows righteousness gets a true reward.
versions.niv: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, but the one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
versions.nkjv: The wicked man does deceptive work, But he who sows righteousness willhave a sure reward.
versions.web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

versions.asv: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
versions.csb: For the Lord is good, and his faithful love endures forever; his faithfulness, through all generations.
versions.esv: For the Lord is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
versions.kjv: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
versions.nasb: For the Lord is good; His mercy is everlasting And His faithfulness is to all generations.
versions.niv: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
versions.nkjv: For the Lordis good; His mercy is everlasting, And His truth endures to all generations.
versions.web: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

versions.asv: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
versions.csb: God, you are my God; I eagerly seek you. I thirst for you; my body faints for you in a land that is dry, desolate, and without water.
versions.esv: O God, you are my God; earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you; my flesh faints for you, as in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
versions.kjv: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
versions.nasb: God, You are my God; I shall be watching for You; My soul thirsts for You, my flesh yearns for You, In a dry and exhausted land where there is no water.
versions.niv: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.
versions.nkjv: O God, You are my God; Early will I seek You; My soul thirsts for You; My flesh longs for You In a dry and thirsty land Where there is no water.
versions.web: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

versions.asv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Jehovah is risen upon thee.
versions.csb: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord shines over you.,
versions.esv: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord has risen upon you.
versions.kjv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
versions.nasb: Arise, shine; for your light has come, And the glory of the Lord has risen upon you.
versions.niv: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.
versions.nkjv: Arise, shine; For your light has come! And the glory of the Lord is risen upon you.
versions.web: Arise, shine ; for your light has come, and Yahweh ’s glory has risen on you !

versions.asv: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with wrathful rebukes; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
versions.csb: I will execute severe vengeance against them with furious rebukes. They will know that I am the Lord when I take my vengeance on them.’
versions.esv: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I lay my vengeance upon them.
versions.kjv: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
versions.nasb: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes; and they will know that I am the Lord, when I inflict My vengeance on them." ’
versions.niv: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I take vengeance on them.’
versions.nkjv: I will execute great vengeance on them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I lay My vengeance upon them." ’
versions.web: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them."’

versions.asv: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and the evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth that which is evil: for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
versions.csb: A good person produces good out of the good stored up in his heart. An evil person produces evil out of the evil stored up in his heart, for his mouth speaks from the overflow of the heart.
versions.esv: The good person out of the good treasure of his heart produces good, and the evil person out of his evil treasure produces evil, for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
versions.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
versions.nasb: The good person out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth what is good; and the evil person out of the evil treasure brings forth what is evil; for his mouth speaks from that which fills his heart.
versions.niv: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
versions.nkjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth evil. For out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
versions.web: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

versions.asv: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?
versions.csb: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
versions.esv: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I shall not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
versions.kjv: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
versions.nasb: In God, whose word I praise, In God I have put my trust; I shall not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
versions.niv: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust and am not afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
versions.nkjv: In God (I will praise His word), In God I have put my trust; I will not fear. What can flesh do to me?
versions.web: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me ?

versions.asv: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.
versions.csb: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; I wait for you all day long.
versions.esv: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all the day long.
versions.kjv: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
versions.nasb: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; For You I wait all the day.
versions.niv: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.
versions.nkjv: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; On You I wait all the day.
versions.web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

versions.asv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
versions.csb: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
versions.esv: Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy!
versions.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
versions.nasb: Those who sow in tears shall harvest with joyful shouting.
versions.niv: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
versions.nkjv: Those who sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
versions.web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

versions.asv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherous shall eat violence.
versions.csb: From the fruit of his mouth, a person will enjoy good things, but treacherous people have an appetite for violence.
versions.esv: From the fruit of his mouth a man eats what is good, but the desire of the treacherous is for violence.
versions.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
versions.nasb: From the fruit of a person’s mouth he enjoys good, But the desire of the treacherous is violence.
versions.niv: From the fruit of their lips people enjoy good things, but the unfaithful have an appetite for violence.
versions.nkjv: A man shall eat well by the fruit of his mouth, But the soul of the unfaithful feeds on violence.
versions.web: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

versions.asv: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.
versions.csb: As the Father has loved me, I have also loved you. Remain in my love.
versions.esv: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Abide in my love.
versions.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
versions.nasb: Just as the Father has loved Me, I also have loved you; remain in My love.
versions.niv: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.
versions.nkjv: As the Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love.
versions.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

versions.asv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.
versions.csb: I have told you these things so that my joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
versions.esv: These things I have spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be full.
versions.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
versions.nasb: These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.
versions.niv: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.
versions.nkjv: These things I have spoken to you, that My joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be full.
versions.web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

versions.asv: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
versions.csb: Instead, his delight is in the Lord ’s instruction, and he meditates on it day and night.
versions.esv: but his delight is in the law of the Lord, and on his law he meditates day and night.
versions.kjv: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
versions.nasb: But his delight is in the Law of the Lord, And on His Law he meditates day and night.
versions.niv: but whose delight is in the law of the Lord, and who meditates on his law day and night.
versions.nkjv: But his delight is in the law of the Lord, And in His law he meditates day and night.
versions.web: but his delight is in Yahweh ’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

versions.asv: For what shall a man be profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
versions.csb: For what will it benefit someone if he gains the whole world yet loses his life? Or what will anyone give in exchange for his life?
versions.esv: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his soul? Or what shall a man give in return for his soul?
versions.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
versions.nasb: For what good will it do a person if he gains the whole world, but forfeits his soul? Or what will a person give in exchange for his soul?
versions.niv: What good will it be for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?
versions.nkjv: For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?
versions.web: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life ? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life ?

versions.asv: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.
versions.csb: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but one who hates correction is stupid.
versions.esv: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
versions.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
versions.nasb: One who loves discipline loves knowledge, But one who hates rebuke is stupid.
versions.niv: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is stupid.
versions.nkjv: Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge, But he who hates correction is stupid.
versions.web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

versions.csb: Blessing and cursing come out of the same mouth. My brothers and sisters, these things should not be this way.
versions.esv: From the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
versions.kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
versions.nasb: from the same mouth come both blessing and cursing. My brothers and sisters, these things should not be this way.
versions.niv: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this should not be.
versions.nkjv: Out of the same mouth proceed blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not to be so.
versions.web: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

versions.asv: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
versions.csb: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
versions.esv: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
versions.kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
versions.nasb: who through Him are believers in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
versions.niv: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.
versions.nkjv: who through Him believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
versions.web: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

versions.asv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
versions.csb: How delightfully good when brothers live together in harmony!
versions.esv: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity!
versions.kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
versions.nasb: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brothers to live together in unity!
versions.niv: How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!
versions.nkjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant itis For brethren to dwell together in unity!
versions.web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity !

versions.asv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
versions.csb: Then he said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
versions.esv: And he said to them, "Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel to the whole creation.
versions.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
versions.nasb: And He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
versions.niv: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
versions.nkjv: And He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
versions.web: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

versions.csb: All Scripture is inspired by God, and is profitable for teaching, for rebuking, for correcting, for training in righteousness,
versions.esv: All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
versions.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
versions.nasb: All Scripture is inspired by God and beneficial for teaching, for rebuke, for correction, for training in righteousness;
versions.niv: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,
versions.nkjv: All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,
versions.web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

versions.asv: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another ; and so much the more, as ye see the day drawing nigh.
versions.csb: not neglecting to gather together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging each other, and all the more as you see the day approaching.
versions.esv: not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.
versions.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
versions.nasb: not abandoning our own meeting together, as is the habit of some people, but encouraging one another; and all the more as you see the day drawing near.
versions.niv: not giving up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another—and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
versions.nkjv: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting oneanother, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

versions.asv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
versions.csb: To you, my strength, I sing praises, because God is my stronghold — my faithful God.
versions.esv: O my Strength, I will sing praises to you, for you, O God, are my fortress, the God who shows me steadfast love.
versions.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
versions.nasb: My strength, I will sing praises to You; For God is my refuge, the God who shows me favor.
versions.niv: You are my strength, I sing praise to you; you, God, are my fortress, my God on whom I can rely.
versions.nkjv: To You, O my Strength, I will sing praises; For God is my defense, My God of mercy.
versions.web: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

versions.asv: The righteous cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.
versions.csb: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears, and rescues them from all their troubles.
versions.esv: When the righteous cry for help, the Lord hears and delivers them out of all their troubles.
versions.kjv: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
versions.nasb: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears And rescues them from all their troubles.
versions.niv: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.
versions.nkjv: Therighteous cry out, and the Lord hears, And delivers them out of all their troubles.
versions.web: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

versions.asv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all that ye do be done in love.
versions.csb: Be alert, stand firm in the faith, be courageous, be strong. Do everything in love.
versions.esv: Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong. Let all that you do be done in love.
versions.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all your things be done with charity.
versions.nasb: Be on the alert, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong. All that you do must be done in love.
versions.niv: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong. Do everything in love.
versions.nkjv: Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong. Let all that you do be done with love.
versions.web: Watch ! Stand firm in the faith ! Be courageous! Be strong ! Let all that you do be done in love.

versions.asv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.
versions.csb: Remain in me, and I in you. Just as a branch is unable to produce fruit by itself unless it remains on the vine, neither can you unless you remain in me.
versions.esv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in me.
versions.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
versions.nasb: Remain in Me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit of itself but must remain in the vine, so neither can you unless you remain in Me.

versions.asv: and he sent forth a raven, and it went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth. And he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground; but the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him to the ark; for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: and he put forth his hand, and took her, and brought her in unto him into the ark. And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark; and the dove came in to him at eventide; and, lo, in her mouth an olive-leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth. And he stayed yet other seven days, and sent forth the dove; and she returned not again unto him any more.
versions.csb: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth. Then he sent out a dove to see whether the water on the earth’s surface had gone down, but the dove found no resting place for its foot. It returned to him in the ark because water covered the surface of the whole earth. He reached out and brought it into the ark to himself. So Noah waited seven more days and sent out the dove from the ark again. When the dove came to him at evening, there was a plucked olive leaf in its beak. So Noah knew that the water on the earth’s surface had gone down. After he had waited another seven days, he sent out the dove, but it did not return to him again.
versions.esv: and sent forth a raven. It went to and fro until the waters were dried up from the earth. Then he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters had subsided from the face of the ground. But the dove found no place to set her foot, and she returned to him to the ark, for the waters were still on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her and brought her into the ark with him. He waited another seven days, and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark. And the dove came back to him in the evening, and behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters had subsided from the earth. Then he waited another seven days and sent forth the dove, and she did not return to him anymore.
versions.kjv: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth. Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground; But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark. And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark; And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth. And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
versions.nasb: and he sent out a raven, and it flew here and there until the water was dried up from the earth. Then he sent out a dove, to see if the water was low on the surface of the land; but the dove found no resting place for the sole of its foot, so it returned to him in the ark, for the water was on the surface of all the earth. Then he put out his hand and took it, and brought it into the ark to himself. So he waited another seven days longer; and again he sent out the dove from the ark. And the dove came to him in the evening, and behold, in its beak was a fresh olive leaf. So Noah knew that the water was low on the earth. Then he waited another seven days longer, and sent out the dove; but it did not return to him again.
versions.niv: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth. Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground. But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark. He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark. When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth. He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.
versions.nkjv: Then he sent out a raven, which kept going to and fro until the waters had dried up from the earth. He also sent out from himself a dove, to see if the waters had receded from the face of the ground. But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned into the ark to him, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her, and drew her into the ark to himself. And he waited yet another seven days, and again he sent the dove out from the ark. Then the dove came to him in the evening, and behold, a freshly plucked olive leaf was in her mouth; and Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth. So he waited yet another seven days and sent out the dove, which did not return again to him anymore.
versions.web: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth. He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground, but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship. He waited yet another seven days ; and again he sent the dove out of the ship. The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth. He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove ; and she didn’t return to him any more.
