versions.esv: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ten days you will have tribulation. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
versions.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
versions.nasb: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, so that you will be tested, and you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
versions.niv: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor’s crown.
versions.nkjv: Do not fear any of those things which you are about to suffer. Indeed, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and you will have tribulation ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
versions.web: Don’ t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested ; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

versions.asv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
versions.csb: But you, man of God, flee from these things, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.
versions.esv: But as for you, O man of God, flee these things. Pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, gentleness.
versions.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
versions.nasb: But flee from these things, you man of God, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
versions.niv: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.
versions.nkjv: But you, O man of God, flee these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, gentleness.
versions.web: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

versions.asv: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck Shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
versions.csb: One who becomes stiff-necked, after many reprimands will be shattered instantly — beyond recovery.
versions.esv: He who is often reproved, yet stiffens his neck, will suddenly be broken beyond healing.
versions.kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
versions.nasb: A person often rebuked who becomes obstinate Will suddenly be broken beyond remedy.
versions.niv: Whoever remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.
versions.nkjv: He who is often rebuked, and hardens his neck, Will suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
versions.web: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

versions.asv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
versions.csb: My sheep hear my voice, I know them, and they follow me.
versions.esv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
versions.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
versions.nasb: My sheep listen to My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me;
versions.niv: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
versions.nkjv: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.
versions.web: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

versions.asv: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.
versions.csb: Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure with turmoil.
versions.esv: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble with it.
versions.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
versions.nasb: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord Than great treasure, and turmoil with the treasure.
versions.niv: Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great wealth with turmoil.
versions.nkjv: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, Than great treasure with trouble.
versions.web: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

versions.asv: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.
versions.csb: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. May your gracious Spirit lead me on level ground.
versions.esv: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God! Let your good Spirit lead me on level ground!
versions.kjv: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
versions.nasb: Teach me to do Your will, For You are my God; Let Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
versions.niv: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
versions.nkjv: Teach me to do Your will, For You are my God; Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
versions.web: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

versions.asv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured unto you.
versions.csb: For you will be judged by the same standard with which you judge others, and you will be measured by the same measure you use.
versions.esv: For with the judgment you pronounce you will be judged, and with the measure you use it will be measured to you.
versions.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
versions.nasb: For in the way you judge, you will be judged; and by your standard of measure, it will be measured to you.
versions.niv: For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
versions.nkjv: For with what judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.
versions.web: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged ; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

versions.asv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.
versions.csb: A fool’s way is right in his own eyes, but whoever listens to counsel is wise.
versions.esv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to advice.
versions.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
versions.nasb: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, But a person who listens to advice is wise.
versions.niv: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.
versions.nkjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, But he who heeds counsel is wise.
versions.web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

versions.asv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;
versions.csb: You satisfy me as with rich food;, my mouth will praise you with joyful lips.
versions.esv: My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and my mouth will praise you with joyful lips,
versions.kjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
versions.nasb: My soul is satisfied as with fat and fatness, And my mouth offers praises with joyful lips.
versions.niv: I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.
versions.nkjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness, And my mouth shall praise You with joyful lips.
versions.web: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

versions.asv: If a wise man hath a controversy with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.
versions.csb: If a wise person goes to court with a fool, there will be ranting and raving but no resolution.,
versions.esv: If a wise man has an argument with a fool, the fool only rages and laughs, and there is no quiet.
versions.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
versions.nasb: When a wise person has a controversy with a foolish person, The foolish person either rages or laughs, and there is no rest.
versions.niv: If a wise person goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.
versions.nkjv: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, Whether thefool rages or laughs, thereis no peace.
versions.web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

versions.asv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.
versions.csb: If anyone says, "I love God," and yet hates his brother or sister, he is a liar. For the person who does not love his brother or sister whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.
versions.esv: If anyone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.
versions.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
versions.nasb: If someone says, "I love God," and yet he hates his brother or sister, he is a liar; for the one who does not love his brother and sister whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
versions.niv: Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.
versions.nkjv: If someone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
versions.web: If a man says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar ; for he who doesn’ t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen ?

versions.asv: And she said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant said, It is my master: and she took her veil, and covered herself.
versions.csb: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us? "The servant answered, "It is my master." So she took her veil and covered herself.
versions.esv: and said to the servant, "Who is that man, walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It is my master." So she took her veil and covered herself.
versions.kjv: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
versions.nasb: She said to the servant, "Who is that man walking in the field to meet us?" And the servant said, "He is my master." Then she took her veil and covered herself.
versions.niv: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?" "He is my master," the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
versions.nkjv: for she had said to the servant, "Who is this man walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It is my master." So she took a veil and covered herself.
versions.web: She said to the servant, "Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us ?" The servant said, "It is my master." She took her veil, and covered herself.

versions.asv: For narrow is the gate, and straitened the way, that leadeth unto life, and few are they that find it.
versions.csb: How narrow is the gate and difficult the road that leads to life, and few find it.
versions.esv: For the gate is narrow and the way is hard that leads to life, and those who find it are few.
versions.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
versions.nasb: For the gate is narrow and the way is constricted that leads to life, and there are few who find it.
versions.niv: But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.
versions.nkjv: Because narrow is the gate and difficult is the way which leads to life, and there are few who find it.
versions.web: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life ! There are few who find it.

versions.asv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.csb: Stay awake and pray, so that you won’t enter into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.esv: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.nasb: Keep watching and praying, so that you do not come into temptation; the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.niv: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.nkjv: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
versions.web: Watch and pray, that you don’ t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

versions.asv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ:
versions.csb: Blessed is the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavens in Christ.
versions.esv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places,
versions.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
versions.nasb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
versions.niv: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.
versions.nkjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
versions.web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

versions.asv: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
versions.csb: Satisfy us in the morning with your faithful love so that we may shout with joy and be glad all our days.
versions.esv: Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
versions.kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
versions.nasb: Satisfy us in the morning with Your graciousness, That we may sing for joy and rejoice all our days.
versions.niv: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
versions.nkjv: Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!
versions.web: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

versions.asv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yea, God hath made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything that shall be after him.
versions.csb: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity, consider: God has made the one as well as the other, so that no one can discover anything that will come after him.
versions.esv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider: God has made the one as well as the other, so that man may not find out anything that will be after him.
versions.kjv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
versions.nasb: On the day of prosperity be happy, But on the day of adversity consider: God has made the one as well as the other So that a person will not discover anything that will come after him.
versions.niv: When times are good, be happy; but when times are bad, consider this: God has made the one as well as the other. Therefore, no one can discover anything about their future.
versions.nkjv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, But in the day of adversity consider: Surely God has appointed the one as well as the other, So that man can find out nothing thatwillcome after him.
versions.web: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider ; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

versions.asv: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.
versions.csb: You, Lord, will guard us; you will protect us from this generation forever.
versions.esv: You, O Lord, will keep them; you will guard us from this generation forever.
versions.kjv: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
versions.nasb: You, Lord, will keep them; You will protect him from this generation forever.
versions.niv: You, Lord, will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,
versions.nkjv: You shall keep them, O Lord, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.
versions.web: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

versions.asv: The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
versions.csb: The earth and everything in it, the world and its inhabitants, belong to the Lord ;
versions.esv: The earth is the Lord ’s and the fullness thereof, the world and those who dwell therein,
versions.kjv: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
versions.nasb: The earth is the Lord’s, and all it contains, The world, and those who live in it.
versions.niv: The earth is the Lord ’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;
versions.nkjv: The earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell therein.
versions.web: The earth is Yahweh ’s, with its fullness ; the world, and those who dwell in it.

versions.asv: Thou art all fair, my love; And there is no spot in thee.
versions.csb: You are absolutely beautiful, my darling; there is no imperfection in you.
versions.esv: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no flaw in you.
versions.kjv: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.
versions.nasb: You are altogether beautiful, my darling, And there is no blemish on you.
versions.niv: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; there is no flaw in you.
versions.nkjv: You are all fair, my love, And thereis no spot in you.
versions.web: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.

versions.asv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye abstain from fornication;
versions.csb: For this is God’s will, your sanctification: that you keep away from sexual immorality,
versions.esv: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality;
versions.kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
versions.nasb: For this is the will of God, your sanctification; that is, that you abstain from sexual immorality;
versions.niv: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;
versions.nkjv: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you should abstain from sexual immorality;
versions.web: For this is the will of God : your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

versions.asv: For of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.
versions.csb: Indeed, we have all received grace upon grace from his fullness,
versions.esv: For from his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.
versions.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
versions.nasb: For of His fullness we have all received, and grace upon grace.
versions.niv: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.
versions.nkjv: And of His fullness we have all received, and grace for grace.
versions.web: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

versions.asv: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.
versions.csb: Sons are indeed a heritage from the Lord, offspring, a reward.
versions.esv: Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord, the fruit of the womb a reward.
versions.kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD : and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
versions.nasb: Behold, children are a gift of the Lord, The fruit of the womb is a reward.
versions.niv: Children are a heritage from the Lord, offspring a reward from him.
versions.nkjv: Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord, The fruit of the womb is a reward.
versions.web: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

versions.asv: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
versions.csb: Without guidance, a people will fall, but with many counselors there is deliverance.
versions.esv: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
versions.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
versions.nasb: Where there is no guidance the people fall, But in an abundance of counselors there is victory.
versions.niv: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
versions.nkjv: Where thereis no counsel, the people fall; But in the multitude of counselors thereis safety.
versions.web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

versions.asv: But Jesus turning and seeing her said, Daughter, be of good cheer; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
versions.csb: Jesus turned and saw her. "Have courage, daughter," he said. "Your faith has saved you.", And the woman was made well from that moment.
versions.esv: Jesus turned, and seeing her he said, "Take heart, daughter; your faith has made you well." And instantly the woman was made well.
versions.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
versions.nasb: But Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, "Daughter, take courage; your faith has made you well." And at once the woman was made well.
versions.niv: Jesus turned and saw her. "Take heart, daughter," he said, "your faith has healed you." And the woman was healed at that moment.
versions.nkjv: But Jesus turned around, and when He saw her He said, "Be of good cheer, daughter; your faith has made you well." And the woman was made well from that hour.
versions.web: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, "Daughter, cheer up ! Your faith has made you well." And the woman was made well from that hour.

versions.asv: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
versions.csb: The Lord will always lead you, satisfy you in a parched land, and strengthen your bones. You will be like a watered garden and like a spring whose water never runs dry.
versions.esv: And the Lord will guide you continually and satisfy your desire in scorched places and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered garden, like a spring of water, whose waters do not fail.
versions.kjv: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
versions.nasb: And the Lord will continually guide you, And satisfy your desire in scorched places, And give strength to your bones; And you will be like a watered garden, And like a spring of water whose waters do not fail.
versions.niv: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
versions.nkjv: The Lord will guide you continually, And satisfy your soul in drought, And strengthen your bones; You shall be like a watered garden, And like a spring of water, whose waters do not fail.
versions.web: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

versions.asv: Seeing it is God, that said, Light shall shine out of darkness, who shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
versions.csb: For God who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of God’s glory in the face of Jesus Christ.
versions.esv: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
versions.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
versions.nasb: For God, who said, "Light shall shine out of darkness," is the One who has shone in our hearts to give the Light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.
versions.niv: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory displayed in the face of Christ.
versions.nkjv: For it is the God who commanded light to shine out of darkness, who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
versions.web: seeing it is God who said, "Light will shine out of darkness," who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

versions.asv: The discretion of a man maketh him slow to anger; And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
versions.csb: A person’s insight gives him patience, and his virtue is to overlook an offense.
versions.esv: Good sense makes one slow to anger, and it is his glory to overlook an offense.
versions.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
versions.nasb: A person’s discretion makes him slow to anger, And it is his glory to overlook an offense.
versions.niv: A person’s wisdom yields patience; it is to one’s glory to overlook an offense.
versions.nkjv: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger, And his glory is to overlook a transgression.
versions.web: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

versions.asv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
versions.csb: because the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has set you free from the law of sin and death.
versions.esv: For the law of the Spirit of life has set you free in Christ Jesus from the law of sin and death.
versions.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
versions.nasb: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has set you free from the law of sin and of death.
versions.niv: because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.
versions.nkjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
versions.web: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

versions.asv: But I hold not my life of any account as dear unto myself, so that I may accomplish my course, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
versions.csb: But I consider my life of no value to myself; my purpose is to finish my course and the ministry I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of God’s grace.
versions.esv: But I do not account my life of any value nor as precious to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.
versions.kjv: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
versions.nasb: But I do not consider my life of any account as dear to myself, so that I may finish my course and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify solemnly of the gospel of God’s grace.
versions.niv: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
versions.nkjv: But none of these things move me; nor do I count my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.
versions.web: But these things don’ t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

versions.nkjv: Oh come, let us sing to the Lord! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.
versions.web: Oh come, let ’s sing to Yahweh. Let ’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation !

versions.asv: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.
versions.csb: I have asked one thing from the Lord ; it is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, gazing on the beauty of the Lord and seeking him in his temple.
versions.esv: One thing have I asked of the Lord, that will I seek after: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to inquire in his temple.
versions.kjv: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
versions.nasb: One thing I have asked from the Lord, that I shall seek: That I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the Lord And to meditate in His temple.
versions.niv: One thing I ask from the Lord, this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.
versions.nkjv: One thing I have desired of the Lord, That will I seek: That I may dwell in the house of the Lord All the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the Lord, And to inquire in His temple.
versions.web: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after : that I may dwell in Yahweh ’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh ’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

versions.asv: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial name.
versions.csb: Sing to the Lord, you his faithful ones, and praise his holy name.
versions.esv: Sing praises to the Lord, O you his saints, and give thanks to his holy name.
versions.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
versions.nasb: Sing praise to the Lord, you His godly ones, And praise the mention of His holiness.
versions.niv: Sing the praises of the Lord, you his faithful people; praise his holy name.
versions.nkjv: Sing praise to the Lord, you saints of His, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.
versions.web: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

versions.asv: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
versions.csb: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his faithful love endures forever.
versions.esv: Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!
versions.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
versions.nasb: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; For His mercy is everlasting.
versions.niv: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.
versions.nkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
versions.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

versions.asv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.
versions.csb: But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they don’t know what makes them stumble.
versions.esv: The way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know over what they stumble.
versions.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
versions.nasb: The way of the wicked is like darkness; They do not know over what they stumble.
versions.niv: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
versions.nkjv: The way of the wicked is like darkness; They do not know what makes them stumble.
versions.web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

versions.asv: Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children;
versions.csb: Therefore, be imitators of God, as dearly loved children,
versions.esv: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children.
versions.kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
versions.nasb: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children;
versions.niv: Follow God’s example, therefore, as dearly loved children
versions.nkjv: Therefore be imitators of God as dear children.
versions.web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

versions.asv: For they that are after the flesh mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
versions.csb: For those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit have their minds set on the things of the Spirit.
versions.esv: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
versions.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
versions.nasb: For those who are in accord with the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who are in accord with the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
versions.niv: Those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on what the flesh desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.
versions.nkjv: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those wholive according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
versions.web: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

versions.asv: And let patience have its perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, lacking in nothing.
versions.csb: And let endurance have its full effect, so that you may be mature and complete, lacking nothing.
versions.esv: And let steadfastness have its full effect, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
versions.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
versions.nasb: And let endurance have its perfect result, so that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
versions.niv: Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
versions.nkjv: But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing.
versions.web: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

versions.asv: Honor thy father and thy mother; and, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
versions.csb: honor your father and your mother; and love your neighbor as yourself.,
versions.esv: Honor your father and mother, and, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
versions.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
versions.nasb: Honor your father and mother; and You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
versions.niv: honor your father and mother,’ and ‘love your neighbor as yourself.’
versions.nkjv: ‘Honor your father andyourmother,’ and, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
versions.web: ‘ Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘ You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

versions.asv: And be not drunken with wine, wherein is riot, but be filled with the Spirit;
versions.csb: And don’t get drunk with wine, which leads to reckless living, but be filled by the Spirit:
versions.esv: And do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit,
versions.kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
versions.nasb: And do not get drunk with wine, in which there is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit,
versions.niv: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery. Instead, be filled with the Spirit,
versions.nkjv: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is dissipation; but be filled with the Spirit,
versions.web: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

versions.asv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
versions.csb: See! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
versions.esv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
versions.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
versions.nasb: Behold, I stand at the door and knock; if anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with Me.
versions.niv: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.
versions.nkjv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me.
versions.web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

versions.asv: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
versions.csb: You planned evil against me; God planned it for good to bring about the present result — the survival of many people.
versions.esv: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.
versions.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
versions.nasb: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good in order to bring about this present result, to keep many people alive.
versions.niv: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.
versions.nkjv: But as for you, you meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, in order to bring it about as itis this day, to save many people alive.
versions.web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

versions.asv: But flee youthful lusts, and follow after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
versions.csb: Flee from youthful passions, and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
versions.esv: So flee youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
versions.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
versions.nasb: Now flee from youthful lusts and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
versions.niv: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
versions.nkjv: Flee also youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
versions.web: Flee from youthful lusts ; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

versions.asv: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
versions.csb: Go, therefore, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
versions.esv: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
versions.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
versions.nasb: Go, therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
versions.niv: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
versions.nkjv: Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
versions.web: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

versions.asv: not in the way of eyeservice, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
versions.csb: Don’t work only while being watched, as people-pleasers, but as slaves of Christ, doing God’s will from your heart.
versions.esv: not by the way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as bondservants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
versions.kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
versions.nasb: not by way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart.
versions.niv: Obey them not only to win their favor when their eye is on you, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
versions.nkjv: not with eyeservice, as men-pleasers, but as bondservants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
versions.web: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

versions.asv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
versions.csb: Dear friends, if God loved us in this way, we also must love one another.
versions.esv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
versions.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
versions.nasb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
versions.niv: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
versions.nkjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
versions.web: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

versions.asv: Be patient therefore, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receive the early and latter rain.
versions.csb: Therefore, brothers and sisters, be patient until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth and is patient with it until it receives the early and the late rains.
versions.esv: Be patient, therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient about it, until it receives the early and the late rains.
versions.kjv: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
versions.nasb: Therefore be patient, brothers and sisters, until the coming of the Lord. The farmer waits for the precious produce of the soil, being patient about it, until it gets the early and late rains.
versions.niv: Be patient, then, brothers and sisters, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop, patiently waiting for the autumn and spring rains.
versions.nkjv: Therefore be patient, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, waiting patiently for it until it receives the early and latter rain.
versions.web: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

versions.asv: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; But the righteous giveth and withholdeth not.
versions.csb: He is filled with craving all day long, but the righteous give and don’t hold back.
versions.esv: All day long he craves and craves, but the righteous gives and does not hold back.
versions.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
versions.nasb: All day long he is craving, While the righteous gives and does not hold back.
versions.niv: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.
versions.nkjv: He covets greedily all day long, But the righteous gives and does not spare.
versions.web: There are those who covet greedily all day long ; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

versions.asv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
versions.csb: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see if they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
versions.esv: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, for many false prophets have gone out into the world.
versions.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
versions.nasb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

versions.nkjv: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
versions.web: Beloved, don’ t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

versions.asv: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.
versions.csb: Abundant peace belongs to those who love your instruction; nothing makes them stumble.
versions.esv: Great peace have those who love your law; nothing can make them stumble.
versions.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
versions.nasb: Those who love Your Law have great peace, And nothing causes them to stumble.
versions.niv: Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.
versions.nkjv: Great peace have those who love Your law, And nothing causes them to stumble.
versions.web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

versions.asv: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?
versions.csb: Do not be yoked together with those who do not believe. For what partnership is there between righteousness and lawlessness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
versions.esv: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
versions.kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
versions.nasb: Do not be mismatched with unbelievers; for what do righteousness and lawlessness share together, or what does light have in common with darkness?
versions.niv: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness?
versions.nkjv: Do not be unequally yoked together with unbelievers. For what fellowship has righteousness with lawlessness? And what communion has light with darkness?
versions.web: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have ? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness ?

versions.esv: But he said, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!
versions.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
versions.nasb: But He said, "On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God and follow it.

versions.nkjv: But He said, "More than that, blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it!

versions.csb: God — he clothes me with strength and makes my way perfect.

versions.nasb: The God who encircles me with strength, And makes my way blameless?
versions.niv: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
versions.nkjv: Itis God who arms me with strength, And makes my way perfect.

versions.asv: and on my behalf, that utterance may be given unto me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,

versions.esv: and also for me, that words may be given to me in opening my mouth boldly to proclaim the mystery of the gospel,
versions.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

versions.nkjv: and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,

versions.csb: In my distress I called to the Lord, and he answered me.
versions.esv: In my distress I called to the Lord, and he answered me.
versions.kjv: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
versions.nasb: I cried to the Lord in my trouble, And He answered me.
versions.niv: I call on the Lord in my distress, and he answers me.
versions.nkjv: In my distress I cried to the Lord, And He heard me.
versions.web: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

versions.asv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.
versions.csb: For the needy will not always be forgotten; the hope of the oppressed will not perish forever.
versions.esv: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, and the hope of the poor shall not perish forever.
versions.kjv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
versions.nasb: For the needy will not always be forgotten, Nor the hope of the afflicted perish forever.
versions.niv: But God will never forget the needy; the hope of the afflicted will never perish.
versions.nkjv: For the needy shall not always be forgotten; The expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.
versions.web: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

versions.asv: Grant thee thy heart’s desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.
versions.csb: May he give you what your heart desires and fulfill your whole purpose.
versions.esv: May he grant you your heart’s desire and fulfill all your plans!
versions.kjv: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
versions.nasb: May He grant you your heart’s desire And fulfill your whole plan!
versions.niv: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
versions.nkjv: May He grant you according to your heart’s desire, And fulfill all your purpose.
versions.web: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

versions.kjv: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
versions.nasb: Yet you do not know what your life will be like tomorrow. For you are just a vapor that appears for a little while, and then vanishes away.
versions.niv: Why, you do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
versions.nkjv: whereas you do not know what willhappen tomorrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
versions.web: Yet you don’ t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life ? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

versions.asv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, even Jesus;
