versions.asv: For ye received not the spirit of bondage again unto fear; but ye received the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
versions.csb: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear. Instead, you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry out, "Abba, Father!
versions.esv: For you did not receive the spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons, by whom we cry, "Abba! Father!
versions.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
versions.nasb: For you have not received a spirit of slavery leading to fear again, but you have received a spirit of adoption as sons and daughters by which we cry out, "Abba! Father!
versions.niv: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, "Abba, Father.
versions.nkjv: For you did not receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption by whom we cry out, "Abba, Father.
versions.web: For you didn’ t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, "Abba! Father !

versions.asv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.
versions.csb: Fathers, don’t stir up anger in your children, but bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.
versions.esv: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
versions.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
versions.nasb: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
versions.niv: Fathers, do not exasperate your children; instead, bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.
versions.nkjv: And you, fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the training and admonition of the Lord.
versions.web: You fathers, don’ t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

versions.asv: Rejoice always;
versions.csb: Rejoice always,
versions.esv: Rejoice always,
versions.kjv: Rejoice evermore.
versions.nasb: Rejoice always,
versions.niv: Rejoice always,
versions.nkjv: Rejoice always,
versions.web: Always rejoice.

versions.asv: But from those who were reputed to be somewhat (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth not man’s person)—they, I say, who were of repute imparted nothing to me:
versions.csb: Now from those recognized as important (what they once were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism, ) — they added nothing to me.
versions.esv: And from those who seemed to be influential (what they were makes no difference to me; God shows no partiality)—those, I say, who seemed influential added nothing to me.
versions.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
versions.nasb: But from those who were of considerable repute (what they were makes no difference to me; God shows no favoritism)—well, those who were of repute contributed nothing to me.
versions.niv: As for those who were held in high esteem—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—they added nothing to my message.
versions.nkjv: But from those who seemed to be something—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God shows personal favoritism to no man—for those who seemed tobesomething added nothing to me.
versions.web: But from those who were reputed to be important— whatever they were, it makes no difference to me ; God doesn’ t show partiality to man — they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

versions.asv: Lay hands hastily on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
versions.csb: Don’t be too quick to appoint, anyone as an elder, and don’t share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
versions.esv: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, nor take part in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.
versions.kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
versions.nasb: Do not lay hands upon anyone too quickly and thereby share responsibility for the sins of others; keep yourself free from sin.
versions.niv: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, and do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
versions.nkjv: Do not lay hands on anyone hastily, nor share in other people’s sins; keep yourself pure.
versions.web: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

versions.asv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.
versions.csb: There is a way that seems right to a person, but its end is the way to death.
versions.esv: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death.
versions.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
versions.nasb: There is a way which seems right to a person, But its end is the way of death.
versions.niv: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.
versions.nkjv: There is a way thatseems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.
versions.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

versions.asv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.
versions.csb: For the one who finds me finds life and obtains favor from the Lord,
versions.esv: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the Lord,
versions.kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
versions.nasb: For one who finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the Lord.
versions.niv: For those who find me find life and receive favor from the Lord.
versions.nkjv: For whoever finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the Lord;
versions.web: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

versions.asv: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.csb: nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.esv: nor height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.nasb: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.niv: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.nkjv: nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
versions.web: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God ’ s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

versions.asv: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth consume, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
versions.csb: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves don’t break in and steal.
versions.esv: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal.
versions.kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
versions.nasb: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves do not break in or steal;
versions.niv: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
versions.nkjv: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal.
versions.web: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal ;

versions.asv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; or whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
versions.csb: If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. Therefore, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
versions.esv: For if we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So then, whether we live or whether we die, we are the Lord’s.
versions.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
versions.nasb: for if we live, we live for the Lord, or if we die, we die for the Lord; therefore whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
versions.niv: If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
versions.nkjv: For if we live, we live to the Lord; and if we die, we die to the Lord. Therefore, whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
versions.web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord ’ s.

versions.asv: Worthy art thou, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power: for thou didst create all things, and because of thy will they were, and were created.
versions.csb: Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory and honor and power, because you have created all things, and by your will they exist and were created.
versions.esv: Worthy are you, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they existed and were created.
versions.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
versions.nasb: Worthy are You, our Lord and our God, to receive glory and honor and power; for You created all things, and because of Your will they existed, and were created.
versions.niv: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being.
versions.nkjv: You are worthy, O Lord, To receive glory and honor and power; For You created all things, And by Your will they exist and were created.
versions.web: Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created !

versions.asv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.
versions.csb: I am certain that I will see the Lord ’s goodness in the land of the living.
versions.esv: I believe that I shall look upon the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living!
versions.kjv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
versions.nasb: I certainly believed that I would see the goodness of the Lord In the land of the living.
versions.niv: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
versions.nkjv: Iwouldhavelostheart, unless I had believed That I would see the goodness of the Lord In the land of the living.
versions.web: I am still confident of this : I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

versions.asv: Yea verily, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but refuse, that I may gain Christ,
versions.csb: More than that, I also consider everything to be a loss in view of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. Because of him I have suffered the loss of all things and consider them as dung, so that I may gain Christ
versions.esv: Indeed, I count everything as loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have suffered the loss of all things and count them as rubbish, in order that I may gain Christ
versions.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
versions.nasb: More than that, I count all things to be loss in view of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them mere rubbish, so that I may gain Christ,
versions.niv: What is more, I consider everything a loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have lost all things. I consider them garbage, that I may gain Christ
versions.nkjv: Yet indeed I also count all things loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them as rubbish, that I may gain Christ
versions.web: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

versions.asv: Chasten thy son, seeing there is hope; And set not thy heart on his destruction.
versions.csb: Discipline your son while there is hope; don’t set your heart on being the cause of his death.,
versions.esv: Discipline your son, for there is hope; do not set your heart on putting him to death.
versions.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
versions.nasb: Discipline your son while there is hope, And do not desire his death.
versions.niv: Discipline your children, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to their death.
versions.nkjv: Chasten your son while there is hope, And do not set your heart on his destruction.
versions.web: Discipline your son, for there is hope ; don’t be a willing party to his death.

versions.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
versions.csb: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his faithful love endures forever.
versions.esv: Praise the Lord ! Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!
versions.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
versions.nasb: Praise the Lord! Oh give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; For His mercy is everlasting.
versions.niv: Praise the Lord. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.
versions.nkjv: Praise the Lord! Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
versions.web: Praise Yahweh ! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

versions.asv: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on his faithfulness.
versions.csb: Trust in the Lord and do what is good; dwell in the land and live securely.,
versions.esv: Trust in the Lord, and do good; dwell in the land and befriend faithfulness.
versions.kjv: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
versions.nasb: Trust in the Lord and do good; Live in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
versions.niv: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.
versions.nkjv: Trust in the Lord, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on His faithfulness.
versions.web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

versions.asv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
versions.csb: And he replied, "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.
versions.esv: And he said, "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.
versions.kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
versions.nasb: And He said, "My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest.
versions.niv: The Lord replied, "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.
versions.nkjv: And He said, "My Presence will go withyou, and I will give you rest.
versions.web: He said, "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.

versions.asv: Finally, be ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:
versions.csb: Finally, all of you be like-minded and sympathetic, love one another, and be compassionate and humble,
versions.esv: Finally, all of you, have unity of mind, sympathy, brotherly love, a tender heart, and a humble mind.
versions.kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
versions.nasb: To sum up, all of you be harmonious, sympathetic, loving, compassionate, and humble;
versions.niv: Finally, all of you, be like-minded, be sympathetic, love one another, be compassionate and humble.
versions.nkjv: Finally, all ofyoube of one mind, having compassion for one another; love as brothers, be tenderhearted, be courteous;
versions.web: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

versions.asv: For where jealousy and faction are, there is confusion and every vile deed.
versions.csb: For where there is envy and selfish ambition, there is disorder and every evil practice.
versions.esv: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every vile practice.
versions.kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
versions.nasb: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there is disorder and every evil thing.
versions.niv: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.
versions.nkjv: For where envy and self-seeking exist, confusion and every evil thing are there.
versions.web: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

versions.asv: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I; send me.
versions.csb: Then I heard the voice of the Lord asking: Who will I send? Who will go for us? I said: Here I am. Send me.
versions.esv: And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?" Then I said, "Here I am! Send me.
versions.kjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
versions.nasb: Then I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for Us?" Then I said, "Here am I. Send me!
versions.niv: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?" And I said, "Here am I. Send me!
versions.nkjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying: "Whom shall I send, And who will go for Us?" Then I said, "Here am I! Send me.
versions.web: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for us ?" Then I said, "Here I am. Send me !

versions.asv: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.
versions.csb: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
versions.esv: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
versions.kjv: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
versions.nasb: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You have anointed my head with oil; My cup overflows.
versions.niv: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
versions.nkjv: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.
versions.web: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

versions.asv: The God that made the world and all things therein, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
versions.csb: The God who made the world and everything in it — he is Lord of heaven and earth — does not live in shrines made by hands.
versions.esv: The God who made the world and everything in it, being Lord of heaven and earth, does not live in temples made by man,
versions.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
versions.nasb: The God who made the world and everything that is in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made by hands;
versions.niv: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.
versions.nkjv: God, who made the world and everything in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands.
versions.web: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’ t dwell in temples made with hands.

versions.asv: Thou believest that God is one; thou doest well: the demons also believe, and shudder.
versions.csb: You believe that God is one. Good! Even the demons believe — and they shudder.
versions.esv: You believe that God is one; you do well. Even the demons believe—and shudder!
versions.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
versions.nasb: You believe that God is one. You do well; the demons also believe, and shudder.
versions.niv: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
versions.nkjv: You believe that there is one God. You do well. Even the demons believe—and tremble!
versions.web: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe — and shudder.

versions.asv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.
versions.csb: Turn my eyes from looking at what is worthless; give me life in your ways.,
versions.esv: Turn my eyes from looking at worthless things; and give me life in your ways.
versions.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
versions.nasb: Turn my eyes away from looking at what is worthless, And revive me in Your ways.
versions.niv: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.
versions.nkjv: Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things, And revive me in Your way.
versions.web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

versions.asv: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
versions.csb: Lord, you are my portion and my cup of blessing; you hold my future.
versions.esv: The Lord is my chosen portion and my cup; you hold my lot.
versions.kjv: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
versions.nasb: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You support my lot.
versions.niv: Lord, you alone are my portion and my cup; you make my lot secure.
versions.nkjv: O Lord, Youare the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You maintain my lot.
versions.web: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

versions.asv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
versions.csb: Don’t neglect to do what is good and to share, for God is pleased with such sacrifices.
versions.esv: Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
versions.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
versions.nasb: And do not neglect doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
versions.niv: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
versions.nkjv: But do not forget to do good and to share, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
versions.web: But don’ t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

versions.asv: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.
versions.csb: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him.
versions.esv: As a father shows compassion to his children, so the Lord shows compassion to those who fear him.
versions.kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
versions.nasb: Just as a father has compassion on his children, So the Lord has compassion on those who fear Him.
versions.niv: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;
versions.nkjv: As a father pities his children, So the Lord pities those who fear Him.
versions.web: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

versions.asv: In my Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.
versions.csb: In my Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going to prepare a place for you?
versions.esv: In my Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I go to prepare a place for you?
versions.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
versions.nasb: In My Father’s house are many rooms; if that were not so, I would have told you, because I am going there to prepare a place for you.
versions.niv: My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
versions.nkjv: In My Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so,I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
versions.web: In my Father ’s house are many homes. If it weren’ t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

versions.asv: It is of Jehovah’s lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
versions.csb: Because of the Lord ’s faithful love we do not perish, for his mercies never end.
versions.esv: The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; his mercies never come to an end;
versions.kjv: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
versions.nasb: The Lord’s acts of mercy indeed do not end, For His compassions do not fail.
versions.niv: Because of the Lord ’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.
versions.nkjv: Through the Lord’s mercies we are not consumed, Because His compassions fail not.
versions.web: It is because of Yahweh ’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

versions.asv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry; for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
versions.csb: Don’t let your spirit rush to be angry, for anger abides in the heart of fools.
versions.esv: Be not quick in your spirit to become angry, for anger lodges in the heart of fools.
versions.kjv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
versions.nasb: Do not be eager in your spirit to be angry, For anger resides in the heart of fools.
versions.niv: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger resides in the lap of fools.
versions.nkjv: Do not hasten in your spirit to be angry, For anger rests in the bosom of fools.
versions.web: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

versions.asv: but if a man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
versions.csb: But if anyone suffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed but let him glorify God in having that name.
versions.esv: Yet if anyone suffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in that name.
versions.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
versions.nasb: but if anyone suffers as a Christian, he is not to be ashamed, but is to glorify God in this name.
versions.niv: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.
versions.nkjv: Yet if anyonesuffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in this matter.
versions.web: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

versions.asv: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
versions.csb: Serve the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
versions.esv: Serve the Lord with gladness! Come into his presence with singing!
versions.kjv: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
versions.nasb: Serve the Lord with jubilation; Come before Him with rejoicing.
versions.niv: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
versions.nkjv: Serve the Lord with gladness; Come before His presence with singing.
versions.web: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

versions.asv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
versions.csb: Better a day in your courts than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God than live in the tents of wicked people.

versions.asv: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.csb: Therefore, since we also have such a large cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let us lay aside every hindrance and the sin that so easily ensnares us. Let us run with endurance the race that lies before us, keeping our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of our faith. For the joy that lay before him, he endured the cross, despising the shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.esv: Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us also lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the founder and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is seated at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.nasb: Therefore, since we also have such a great cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let’s rid ourselves of every obstacle and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking only at Jesus, the originator and perfecter of the faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.niv: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us, fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.nkjv: Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
versions.web: Therefore let ’ s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let ’ s run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

versions.niv: Let the message of Christ dwell among you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts.
versions.nkjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
versions.web: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly ; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

versions.asv: For judgment is without mercy to him that hath showed no mercy: mercy glorieth against judgment.
versions.csb: For judgment is without mercy to the one who has not shown mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
versions.esv: For judgment is without mercy to one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
versions.kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
versions.nasb: For judgment will be merciless to one who has shown no mercy; mercy triumphs over judgment.
versions.niv: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
versions.nkjv: For judgment is without mercy to the one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
versions.web: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

versions.csb: Lashes and wounds purge away evil, and beatings cleanse the innermost parts.
versions.esv: Blows that wound cleanse away evil; strokes make clean the innermost parts.
versions.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
versions.nasb: Bruising wounds clean away evil, And blows cleanse the innermost parts.
versions.niv: Blows and wounds scrub away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.
versions.nkjv: Blows that hurt cleanse away evil, As do stripes the inner depths of the heart.
versions.web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

versions.asv: No man can come to me, except the Father that sent me draw him: and I will raise him up in the last day.
versions.csb: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up on the last day.
versions.esv: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him. And I will raise him up on the last day.
versions.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
versions.nasb: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up on the last day.
versions.niv: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.
versions.nkjv: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.
versions.web: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him ; and I will raise him up in the last day.

versions.asv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
versions.csb: As a deer longs for flowing streams, so I long for you, God.
versions.esv: As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for you, O God.
versions.kjv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
versions.nasb: As the deer pants for the water brooks, So my soul pants for You, God.
versions.niv: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.
versions.nkjv: As the deer pants for the water brooks, So pants my soul for You, O God.
versions.web: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God. "(Elohim).

versions.asv: But watch ye at every season, making supplication, that ye may prevail to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
versions.csb: But be alert at all times, praying that you may have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place and to stand before the Son of Man.
versions.esv: But stay awake at all times, praying that you may have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place, and to stand before the Son of Man.
versions.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
versions.nasb: But stay alert at all times, praying that you will have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place, and to stand before the Son of Man.
versions.niv: Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man.
versions.nkjv: Watch therefore, and pray always that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Man.
versions.web: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.

versions.esv: Indeed, we felt that we had received the sentence of death. But that was to make us rely not on ourselves but on God who raises the dead.
versions.kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
versions.nasb: Indeed, we had the sentence of death within ourselves so that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
versions.niv: Indeed, we felt we had received the sentence of death. But this happened that we might not rely on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead.
versions.nkjv: Yes, we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves but in God who raises the dead,
versions.web: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

versions.asv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.

versions.nkjv: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.

versions.csb: You will indeed go out with joy and be peacefully guided; the mountains and the hills will break into singing before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
versions.esv: For you shall go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and the hills before you shall break forth into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

versions.csb: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who substitute darkness for light and light for darkness, who substitute bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.
versions.esv: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!

versions.asv: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
versions.csb: For as heaven is higher than earth, so my ways are higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

versions.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

versions.nkjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
versions.web: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

versions.niv: From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward.
versions.nkjv: A man will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth, And the recompense of a man’s hands will be rendered to him.
versions.web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man ’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

versions.asv: He that findeth his life shall lose it; and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
versions.csb: Anyone who finds his life will lose it, and anyone who loses his life because of me will find it.
versions.esv: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.
versions.kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
versions.nasb: The one who has found his life will lose it, and the one who has lost his life on My account will find it.
versions.niv: Whoever finds their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.
versions.nkjv: He who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for My sake will find it.
versions.web: He who seeks his life will lose it ; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

versions.asv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.
versions.csb: The one who oppresses the poor person insults his Maker, but one who is kind to the needy honors him.
versions.esv: Whoever oppresses a poor man insults his Maker, but he who is generous to the needy honors him.
versions.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
versions.nasb: One who oppresses the poor taunts his Maker, But one who is gracious to the needy honors Him.
versions.niv: Whoever oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.
versions.nkjv: He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker, But he who honors Him has mercy on the needy.
versions.web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

versions.asv: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
versions.csb: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.
versions.esv: For the kingdom of God does not consist in talk but in power.
versions.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
versions.nasb: For the kingdom of God is not in words, but in power.
versions.niv: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.
versions.nkjv: For the kingdom of God is not in word but in power.
versions.web: For God ’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

versions.asv: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.
versions.csb: Lord, set up a guard for my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
versions.esv: Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips!
versions.kjv: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
versions.nasb: Set a guard, Lord, over my mouth; Keep watch over the door of my lips.
versions.niv: Set a guard over my mouth, Lord ; keep watch over the door of my lips.
versions.nkjv: Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth; Keep watch over the door of my lips.
versions.web: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

versions.asv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
versions.csb: The slacker craves, yet has nothing, but the diligent is fully satisfied.
versions.esv: The soul of the sluggard craves and gets nothing, while the soul of the diligent is richly supplied.
versions.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
versions.nasb: The soul of the lazy one craves and gets nothing, But the soul of the diligent is made prosperous.
versions.niv: A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.
versions.nkjv: The soul of a lazy man desires, and has nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.
versions.web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

versions.asv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the hearts.
versions.csb: All a person’s ways seem right to him, but the Lord weighs hearts.
versions.esv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the Lord weighs the heart.
versions.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
versions.nasb: Every person’s way is right in his own eyes, But the Lord examines the hearts.
versions.niv: A person may think their own ways are right, but the Lord weighs the heart.
versions.nkjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, But the Lord weighs the hearts.
versions.web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.

versions.asv: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.
versions.csb: Pay homage to the Son or he will be angry and you will perish in your rebellion,, for his anger may ignite at any moment. All who take refuge in him are happy.
versions.esv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish in the way, for his wrath is quickly kindled. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
versions.kjv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
versions.nasb: Kiss the Son, that He not be angry and you perish on the way, For His wrath may be kindled quickly. How blessed are all who take refuge in Him!
versions.niv: Kiss his son, or he will be angry and your way will lead to your destruction, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
versions.nkjv: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, And you perish in the way, When His wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all those who put their trust in Him.
versions.web: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

versions.asv: Heal me, O Jehovah, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
versions.csb: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for you are my praise.
versions.esv: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved, for you are my praise.
versions.kjv: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
versions.nasb: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; Save me and I will be saved, For You are my praise.
versions.niv: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.
versions.nkjv: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; Save me, and I shall be saved, For You are my praise.
versions.web: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved ; for you are my praise.

versions.asv: Ye therefore shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
versions.csb: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
versions.esv: You therefore must be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
versions.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
versions.nasb: Therefore you shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
versions.niv: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
versions.nkjv: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
versions.web: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

versions.asv: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.
versions.csb: And we exhort you, brothers and sisters: warn those who are idle, comfort the discouraged, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
versions.esv: And we urge you, brothers, admonish the idle, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with them all.
versions.kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
versions.nasb: We urge you, brothers and sisters, admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
versions.niv: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
versions.nkjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn those who are unruly, comfort the fainthearted, uphold the weak, be patient with all.
versions.web: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

versions.asv: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears unto their supplication: But the face of the Lord is upon them that do evil.
versions.csb: because the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are open to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do what is evil.
versions.esv: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.
versions.kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
versions.nasb: For the eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, And His ears attend to their prayer, But the face of the Lord is against evildoers.
versions.niv: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.
versions.nkjv: For the eyes of the Lordare on the righteous, And His ears areopen to their prayers; But the face of the Lordis against those who do evil.
versions.web: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer ; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

versions.asv: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed thereto according to thy word.
versions.csb: How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping your word.
versions.esv: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word.
versions.kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
versions.nasb: How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping it according to Your word.
versions.niv: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.
versions.nkjv: How can a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.
versions.web: How can a young man keep his way pure ? By living according to your word.

versions.asv: Thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift.
versions.csb: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!
versions.esv: Thanks be to God for his inexpressible gift!
versions.kjv: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
versions.nasb: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
versions.niv: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!
versions.nkjv: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
versions.web: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift !

versions.asv: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher powers: for there is no power but of God; and the powers that be are ordained of God.
versions.csb: Let everyone submit to the governing authorities, since there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist are instituted by God.
versions.esv: Let every person be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been instituted by God.
versions.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
versions.nasb: Every person is to be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those which exist are established by God.
versions.niv: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established. The authorities that exist have been established by God.
versions.nkjv: Let every soul be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist are appointed by God.
versions.web: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

versions.asv: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.
versions.csb: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness!
versions.esv: they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
versions.kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
versions.nasb: They are new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
versions.niv: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
versions.nkjv: Theyare new every morning; Great is Your faithfulness.
versions.web: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

versions.asv: And blessed is she that believed; for there shall be a fulfilment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord.
versions.csb: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill what he has spoken to her!
versions.esv: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her from the Lord.
versions.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
versions.nasb: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what had been spoken to her by the Lord.
versions.niv: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!
versions.nkjv: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of those things which were told her from the Lord.
versions.web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord !

versions.asv: He that believeth on the Son hath eternal life; but he that obeyeth not the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abideth on him.
versions.csb: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life, but the one who rejects the Son will not see life; instead, the wrath of God remains on him.
versions.esv: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life; whoever does not obey the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.
versions.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
versions.nasb: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; but the one who does not obey the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.
versions.niv: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.
versions.nkjv: He who believes in the Son has everlasting life; and he who does not believe the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides on him.
versions.web: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’ t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.

versions.asv: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof; and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
versions.csb: The end of a matter is better than its beginning; a patient spirit is better than a proud spirit.
versions.esv: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning, and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
versions.kjv: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
versions.nasb: The end of a matter is better than its beginning; Patience of spirit is better than arrogance of spirit.
versions.niv: The end of a matter is better than its beginning, and patience is better than pride.
versions.nkjv: The end of a thing is better than its beginning; The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
versions.web: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

versions.asv: And therefore will Jehovah wait, that he may be gracious unto you; and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for Jehovah is a God of justice; blessed are all they that wait for him.
versions.csb: Therefore the Lord is waiting to show you mercy, and is rising up to show you compassion, for the Lord is a just God. All who wait patiently for him are happy.
versions.esv: Therefore the Lord waits to be gracious to you, and therefore he exalts himself to show mercy to you. For the Lord is a God of justice; blessed are all those who wait for him.
versions.kjv: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
versions.nasb: Therefore the Lord longs to be gracious to you, And therefore He waits on high to have compassion on you. For the Lord is a God of justice; How blessed are all those who long for Him.
versions.niv: Yet the Lord longs to be gracious to you; therefore he will rise up to show you compassion. For the Lord is a God of justice. Blessed are all who wait for him!
versions.nkjv: Therefore the Lord will wait, that He may be gracious to you; And therefore He will be exalted, that He may have mercy on you. For the Lordis a God of justice; Blessed are all those who wait for Him.
versions.web: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you ; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

versions.asv: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;
versions.csb: Just as each one has received a gift, use it to serve others, as good stewards of the varied grace of God.
versions.esv: As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another, as good stewards of God’s varied grace:
versions.kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
versions.nasb: As each one has received a special gift, employ it in serving one another as good stewards of the multifaceted grace of God.
versions.niv: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s grace in its various forms.
versions.nkjv: As each one has received a gift, minister it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
versions.web: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

versions.asv: But as for me, I will look unto Jehovah; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
versions.csb: But I will look to the Lord ; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
versions.esv: But as for me, I will look to the Lord ; I will wait for the God of my salvation; my God will hear me.
versions.kjv: Therefore I will look unto the LORD ; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
versions.nasb: But as for me, I will be on the watch for the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
versions.niv: But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.
versions.nkjv: Therefore I will look to the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation; My God will hear me.
versions.web: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

versions.asv: But of that day or that hour knoweth no one, not even the angels in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
versions.csb: Now concerning that day or hour no one knows — neither the angels in heaven nor the Son — but only the Father.
versions.esv: But concerning that day or that hour, no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
versions.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
versions.nasb: But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but the Father alone.
versions.niv: But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
versions.nkjv: But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
versions.web: But of that day or that hour no one knows — not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

versions.asv: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
versions.csb: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His faithful love endures forever.
versions.esv: Give thanks to the God of heaven, for his steadfast love endures forever.
versions.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
versions.nasb: Give thanks to the God of heaven, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
versions.niv: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.
versions.nkjv: Oh, give thanks to the God of heaven! For His mercy endures forever.
versions.web: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

versions.asv: for the Lamb that is in the midst of the throne shall be their shepherd, and shall guide them unto fountains of waters of life: and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes.
versions.csb: For the Lamb who is at the center of the throne will shepherd them; he will guide them to springs of the waters of life, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
versions.esv: For the Lamb in the midst of the throne will be their shepherd, and he will guide them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
versions.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
versions.nasb: for the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd, and will guide them to springs of the water of life; and God will wipe every tear from their eyes.
versions.niv: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’ ‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’
versions.nkjv: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and lead them to living fountains of waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
versions.web: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

versions.asv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
versions.csb: You will be hated by everyone because of my name, but the one who endures to the end will be saved.
versions.esv: And you will be hated by all for my name’s sake. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
versions.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
versions.nasb: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name, but it is the one who has endured to the end who will be saved.
versions.niv: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
versions.nkjv: And you will be hated by all for My name’s sake. But he who endures to the end shall be saved.
versions.web: You will be hated by all men for my name ’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

versions.asv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (then saith he to the sick of the palsy), Arise, and take up thy bed, and go unto thy house.
versions.csb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins" — then he told the paralytic, "Get up, take your stretcher, and go home.
versions.esv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—he then said to the paralytic—"Rise, pick up your bed and go home.
versions.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
versions.nasb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—then He *said to the paralyzed man, "Get up, pick up your stretcher and go home.
versions.niv: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins." So he said to the paralyzed man, "Get up, take your mat and go home.
versions.nkjv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins"—then He said to the paralytic, "Arise, take up your bed, and go to your house.
versions.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—" ( then he said to the paralytic ), "Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.

versions.asv: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.
versions.csb: In this, love is made complete with us so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment, because as he is, so also are we in this world.
versions.esv: By this is love perfected with us, so that we may have confidence for the day of judgment, because as he is so also are we in this world.
versions.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
versions.nasb: By this, love is perfected with us, so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment; because as He is, we also are in this world.
versions.niv: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.
versions.nkjv: Love has been perfected among us in this: that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as He is, so are we in this world.
versions.web: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

versions.asv: And we have believed and know that thou art the Holy One of God.
versions.csb: We have come to believe and know that you are the Holy One of God.",
versions.esv: and we have believed, and have come to know, that you are the Holy One of God.
versions.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
versions.nasb: And we have already believed and have come to know that You are the Holy One of God.
versions.niv: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.
versions.nkjv: Also we have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
versions.web: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

versions.asv: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness; and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:
versions.csb: And not only that, but we also boast in our afflictions, because we know that affliction produces endurance, endurance produces proven character, and proven character produces hope.
versions.esv: Not only that, but we rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces endurance, and endurance produces character, and character produces hope,
versions.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
versions.nasb: And not only this, but we also celebrate in our tribulations, knowing that tribulation brings about perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
versions.niv: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
versions.nkjv: And not only that, but we also glory in tribulations, knowing that tribulation produces perseverance; and perseverance, character; and character, hope.
versions.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance ; and perseverance, proven character ; and proven character, hope ;

versions.asv: By long forbearing is a ruler persuaded, And a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
versions.csb: A ruler can be persuaded through patience, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
versions.esv: With patience a ruler may be persuaded, and a soft tongue will break a bone.
versions.kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
versions.nasb: Through patience a ruler may be persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks bone.
versions.niv: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
versions.nkjv: By long forbearance a ruler is persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks a bone.
versions.web: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

versions.asv: Do all things without murmurings and questionings:
versions.csb: Do everything without grumbling and arguing,
versions.esv: Do all things without grumbling or disputing,
versions.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
versions.nasb: Do all things without complaining or arguments;
versions.niv: Do everything without grumbling or arguing,
versions.nkjv: Do all things without complaining and disputing,
versions.web: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

versions.asv: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
versions.csb: So if you have been raised with Christ, seek the things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
