versions.nasb: A father of the fatherless and a judge for the widows, Is God in His holy dwelling.
versions.niv: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.
versions.nkjv: A father of the fatherless, a defender of widows, Is God in His holy habitation.
versions.web: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

versions.asv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
versions.csb: Jesus answered, "If anyone loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
versions.esv: Jesus answered him, "If anyone loves me, he will keep my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
versions.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
versions.nasb: Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will follow My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our dwelling with him.
versions.niv: Jesus replied, "Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
versions.nkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
versions.web: Jesus answered him, "If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

versions.asv: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.
versions.csb: The precepts of the Lord are right, making the heart glad; the command of the Lord is radiant, making the eyes light up.
versions.esv: the precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes;
versions.kjv: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
versions.nasb: The precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
versions.niv: The precepts of the Lord are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
versions.nkjv: The statutes of the Lordare right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the Lordis pure, enlightening the eyes;
versions.web: Yahweh ’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh ’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

versions.asv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying on your behalf: I am filled with comfort, I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
versions.csb: I am very frank with you; I have great pride in you. I am filled with encouragement; I am overflowing with joy in all our afflictions.
versions.esv: I am acting with great boldness toward you; I have great pride in you; I am filled with comfort. In all our affliction, I am overflowing with joy.
versions.kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
versions.nasb: My confidence in you is great; my boasting in your behalf is great. I am filled with comfort; I am overflowing with joy in all our affliction.
versions.niv: I have spoken to you with great frankness; I take great pride in you. I am greatly encouraged; in all our troubles my joy knows no bounds.
versions.nkjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I am exceedingly joyful in all our tribulation.
versions.web: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

versions.asv: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.
versions.csb: Now this is his command: that we believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another as he commanded us.
versions.esv: And this is his commandment, that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as he has commanded us.
versions.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
versions.nasb: This is His commandment, that we believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as He commanded us.
versions.niv: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.
versions.nkjv: And this is His commandment: that we should believe on the name of His Son Jesus Christ and love one another, as He gave us commandment.
versions.web: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

versions.asv: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith Jehovah: shall I that cause to bring forth shut the womb ? saith thy God.
versions.csb: Will I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it? "says the Lord ; "or will I who deliver, close the womb? "says your God.
versions.esv: Shall I bring to the point of birth and not cause to bring forth?" says the Lord ; "shall I, who cause to bring forth, shut the womb?" says your God.
versions.kjv: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD : shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb ? saith thy God.
versions.nasb: Shall I bring to the point of birth but not give delivery?" says the Lord. "Or shall I who gives delivery shut the womb?" says your God.
versions.niv: Do I bring to the moment of birth and not give delivery?" says the Lord. "Do I close up the womb when I bring to delivery?" says your God.
versions.nkjv: Shall I bring to the time of birth, and not cause delivery?" says the Lord. "Shall I who cause delivery shut up thewomb?" says your God.
versions.web: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered ?" says Yahweh. "Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?" says your God.

versions.asv: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
versions.csb: The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
versions.esv: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter until full day.
versions.kjv: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
versions.nasb: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn That shines brighter and brighter until the full day.
versions.niv: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.
versions.nkjv: But the path of the just is like the shining sun, That shines ever brighter unto the perfect day.
versions.web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

versions.asv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
versions.csb: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue, only a moment.
versions.esv: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
versions.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
versions.nasb: Truthful lips will endure forever, But a lying tongue is only for a moment.
versions.niv: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
versions.nkjv: The truthful lip shall be established forever, But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
versions.web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

versions.asv: This is the end of the matter; all hath been heard: Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
versions.csb: When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: fear God and keep his commands, because this is for all humanity.
versions.esv: The end of the matter; all has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man.
versions.kjv: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
versions.nasb: The conclusion, when everything has been heard, is: fear God and keep His commandments, because this applies to every person.
versions.niv: Now all has been heard; here is the conclusion of the matter: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the duty of all mankind.
versions.nkjv: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God and keep His commandments, For this is man’s all.
versions.web: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments ; for this is the whole duty of man.

versions.asv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and railing, be put away from you, with all malice:
versions.csb: Let all bitterness, anger and wrath, shouting and slander be removed from you, along with all malice.
versions.esv: Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and clamor and slander be put away from you, along with all malice.
versions.kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
versions.nasb: All bitterness, wrath, anger, clamor, and slander must be removed from you, along with all malice.
versions.niv: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice.
versions.nkjv: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, clamor, and evil speaking be put away from you, with all malice.
versions.web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

versions.asv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father it is your will to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and standeth not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.
versions.csb: You are of your father the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he tells a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
versions.esv: You are of your father the devil, and your will is to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks out of his own character, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
versions.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
versions.nasb: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. Whenever he tells a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
versions.niv: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
versions.nkjv: You are of your father the devil, and the desires of your father you want to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own resources, for he is a liar and the father of it.
versions.web: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’ t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own ; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

versions.asv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the spirits.
versions.csb: All a person’s ways seem right to him, but the Lord weighs motives.,
versions.esv: All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, but the Lord weighs the spirit.
versions.kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
versions.nasb: All the ways of a person are clean in his own sight, But the Lord examines the motives.
versions.niv: All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord.
versions.nkjv: All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, But the Lord weighs the spirits.
versions.web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.

versions.asv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler; And whosoever erreth thereby is not wise.
versions.csb: Wine is a mocker, beer is a brawler; whoever goes astray because of them is not wise.
versions.esv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
versions.kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
versions.nasb: Wine is a mocker, intoxicating drink a brawler, And whoever is intoxicated by it is not wise.
versions.niv: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
versions.nkjv: Wine is a mocker, Strong drink is a brawler, And whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
versions.web: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

versions.asv: if so be that ye continue in the faith, grounded and stedfast, and not moved away from the hope of the gospel which ye heard, which was preached in all creation under heaven; whereof I Paul was made a minister.
versions.csb: if indeed you remain grounded and steadfast in the faith and are not shifted away from the hope of the gospel that you heard. This gospel has been proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and I, Paul, have become a servant of it.
versions.esv: if indeed you continue in the faith, stable and steadfast, not shifting from the hope of the gospel that you heard, which has been proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and of which I, Paul, became a minister.
versions.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
versions.nasb: if indeed you continue in the faith firmly established and steadfast, and not shifting from the hope of the gospel that you have heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and of which I, Paul, was made a minister.
versions.niv: if you continue in your faith, established and firm, and do not move from the hope held out in the gospel. This is the gospel that you heard and that has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
versions.nkjv: if indeed you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and are not moved away from the hope of the gospel which you heard, which was preached to every creature under heaven, of which I, Paul, became a minister.
versions.web: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

versions.asv: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
versions.csb: They claim to know God, but they deny him by their works. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
versions.esv: They profess to know God, but they deny him by their works. They are detestable, disobedient, unfit for any good work.
versions.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
versions.nasb: They profess to know God, but by their deeds they deny Him, being detestable and disobedient and worthless for any good deed.
versions.niv: They claim to know God, but by their actions they deny him. They are detestable, disobedient and unfit for doing anything good.
versions.nkjv: They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable, disobedient, and disqualified for every good work.
versions.web: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

versions.asv: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.csb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace will reign through righteousness, resulting in eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.esv: so that, as sin reigned in death, grace also might reign through righteousness leading to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.nasb: so that, as sin reigned in death, so also grace would reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.niv: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.nkjv: so that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
versions.web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

versions.asv: Cast not away therefore your boldness, which hath great recompense of reward.
versions.csb: So don’t throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
versions.esv: Therefore do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
versions.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
versions.nasb: Therefore, do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
versions.niv: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.
versions.nkjv: Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great reward.
versions.web: Therefore don’ t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

versions.asv: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
versions.csb: I waited patiently for the Lord, and he turned to me and heard my cry for help.
versions.esv: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he inclined to me and heard my cry.
versions.kjv: I waited patiently for the LORD ; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
versions.nasb: I waited patiently for the Lord; And He reached down to me and heard my cry.
versions.niv: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he turned to me and heard my cry.
versions.nkjv: I waited patiently for the Lord; And He inclined to me, And heard my cry.
versions.web: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

versions.asv: For every one that exalteth himself shall be humbled; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
versions.csb: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.
versions.esv: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.
versions.kjv: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
versions.nasb: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.
versions.niv: For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.
versions.nkjv: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.
versions.web: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

versions.asv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of Jehovah.
versions.csb: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory comes from the Lord.
versions.esv: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but the victory belongs to the Lord.
versions.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
versions.nasb: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, But the victory belongs to the Lord.
versions.niv: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the Lord.
versions.nkjv: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, But deliverance is of the Lord.
versions.web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle ; but victory is with Yahweh.

versions.asv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
versions.csb: For this is what love for God is: to keep his commands. And his commands are not a burden,
versions.esv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not burdensome.
versions.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
versions.nasb: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments; and His commandments are not burdensome.
versions.niv: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,
versions.nkjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome.
versions.web: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

versions.asv: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.
versions.csb: The inexperienced one believes anything, but the sensible one watches his steps.
versions.esv: The simple believes everything, but the prudent gives thought to his steps.
versions.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
versions.nasb: The naive believes everything, But the sensible person considers his steps.
versions.niv: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
versions.nkjv: The simple believes every word, But the prudent considers well his steps.
versions.web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

versions.asv: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
versions.csb: The righteous hate lying, but the wicked bring disgust and shame.
versions.esv: The righteous hates falsehood, but the wicked brings shame and disgrace.
versions.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
versions.nasb: A righteous person hates a false statement, But a wicked person acts disgustingly and shamefully.
versions.niv: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked make themselves a stench and bring shame on themselves.
versions.nkjv: A righteous man hates lying, But a wicked man is loathsome and comes to shame.
versions.web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

versions.asv: In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain;
versions.csb: I have taken refuge in the Lord. How can you say to me, "Escape to the mountains like a bird!
versions.esv: In the Lord I take refuge; how can you say to my soul, Flee like a bird to your mountain,
versions.kjv: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
versions.nasb: In the Lord I take refuge; How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain?
versions.niv: In the Lord I take refuge. How then can you say to me: "Flee like a bird to your mountain.
versions.nkjv: In the Lord I put my trust; How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain"?
versions.web: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain "?

versions.asv: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.
versions.csb: In the fear of the Lord one has strong confidence and his children have a refuge.
versions.esv: In the fear of the Lord one has strong confidence, and his children will have a refuge.
versions.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
versions.nasb: In the fear of the Lord there is strong confidence, And his children will have refuge.
versions.niv: Whoever fears the Lord has a secure fortress, and for their children it will be a refuge.
versions.nkjv: In the fear of the Lordthereis strong confidence, And His children will have a place of refuge.
versions.web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

versions.asv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
versions.csb: So, whoever thinks he stands must be careful not to fall.
versions.esv: Therefore let anyone who thinks that he stands take heed lest he fall.
versions.kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
versions.nasb: Therefore let the one who thinks he stands watch out that he does not fall.
versions.niv: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don’t fall!
versions.nkjv: Therefore let him who thinks he stands take heed lest he fall.
versions.web: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’ t fall.

versions.asv: Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into manifold temptations; knowing that the proving of your faith worketh patience.
versions.csb: Consider it a great joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you experience various trials, because you know that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
versions.esv: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you meet trials of various kinds, for you know that the testing of your faith produces steadfastness.
versions.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
versions.nasb: Consider it all joy, my brothers and sisters, when you encounter various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
versions.niv: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.
versions.nkjv: My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience.
versions.web: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

versions.asv: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men, instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;
versions.csb: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation for all people, instructing us to deny godlessness and worldly lusts and to live in a sensible, righteous, and godly way in the present age,
versions.esv: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation for all people, training us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
versions.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
versions.nasb: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people, instructing us to deny ungodliness and worldly desires and to live sensibly, righteously, and in a godly manner in the present age,
versions.niv: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people. It teaches us to say "No" to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,
versions.nkjv: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men, teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present age,
versions.web: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men, instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

versions.asv: For the word of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us who are saved it is the power of God.
versions.csb: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but it is the power of God to us who are being saved.
versions.esv: For the word of the cross is folly to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
versions.kjv: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
versions.nasb: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
versions.niv: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
versions.nkjv: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
versions.web: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

versions.asv: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.
versions.csb: Don’t let your mouth speak dishonestly, and don’t let your lips talk deviously.
versions.esv: Put away from you crooked speech, and put devious talk far from you.
versions.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
versions.nasb: Rid yourself of a deceitful mouth And keep devious speech far from you.
versions.niv: Keep your mouth free of perversity; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.
versions.nkjv: Put away from you a deceitful mouth, And put perverse lips far from you.
versions.web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

versions.asv: and thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it; when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

versions.niv: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed," says the Lord, who has compassion on you.

versions.web: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed," says Yahweh who has mercy on you.

versions.asv: Better is a little, with righteousness, Than great revenues with injustice.

versions.asv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou taken up and cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that what he saith cometh to pass; he shall have it.
versions.csb: Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will happen, it will be done for him.
versions.esv: Truly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will come to pass, it will be done for him.
versions.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
versions.nasb: Truly I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is going to happen, it will be granted to him.
versions.niv: Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.
versions.nkjv: For assuredly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be removed and be cast into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says.
versions.web: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘ Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’ t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

versions.kjv: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

versions.nkjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend, But the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

versions.asv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith Jehovah, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope in your latter end. And ye shall call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you. And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
versions.csb: For I know the plans I have for you" — this is the Lord ’s declaration — "plans for your well-being, not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope. You will call to me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You will seek me and find me when you search for me with all your heart.
versions.esv: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope. Then you will call upon me and come and pray to me, and I will hear you. You will seek me and find me, when you seek me with all your heart.
versions.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end. Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you. And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
versions.nasb: For I know the plans that I have for you,’ declares the Lord, ‘plans for prosperity and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope. Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you. And you will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
versions.niv: For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord, "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future. Then you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.
versions.nkjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope. Then you will call upon Me and go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you. And you will seek Me and find Me, when you search for Me with all your heart.
versions.web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you," says Yahweh, "thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future. You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

versions.esv: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry, or the clothing you wear— but let your adorning be the hidden person of the heart with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God’s sight is very precious.
versions.kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
versions.nasb: Your adornment must not be merely the external—braiding the hair, wearing gold jewelry, or putting on apparel; but it should be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in the sight of God.

versions.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
versions.nasb: So then, while we have opportunity, let’s do good to all people, and especially to those who are of the household of the faith.
versions.niv: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

versions.web: So then, as we have opportunity, let ’ s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

versions.asv: Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than the food, and the body than the raiment? Behold the birds of the heaven, that they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; and your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are not ye of much more value than they? And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life? And why are ye anxious concerning raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: yet I say unto you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. But if God doth so clothe the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith? Be not therefore anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? For after all these things do the Gentiles seek; for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things. But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
versions.csb: Therefore I tell you: Don’t worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food and the body more than clothing? Consider the birds of the sky: They don’t sow or reap or gather into barns, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you worth more than they? Can any of you add one moment to his life span by worrying? And why do you worry about clothes? Observe how the wildflowers of the field grow: They don’t labor or spin thread. Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was adorned like one of these. If that’s how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and thrown into the furnace tomorrow, won’t he do much more for you — you of little faith? So don’t worry, saying, ‘What will we eat? ’ or ‘What will we drink? ’ or ‘What will we wear? ’ For the Gentiles eagerly seek all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them. But seek first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness, and all these things will be provided for you. Therefore don’t worry about tomorrow, because tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
versions.esv: Therefore I tell you, do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink, nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing? Look at the birds of the air: they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they? And which of you by being anxious can add a single hour to his span of life? And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin, yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is alive and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith? Therefore do not be anxious, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’ For the Gentiles seek after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them all. But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you. "Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble.
versions.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment? Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they? Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature? And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith? Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things. But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
versions.nasb: For this reason I say to you, do not be worried about your life, as to what you will eat or what you will drink; nor for your body, as to what you will put on. Is life not more than food, and the body more than clothing? Look at the birds of the sky, that they do not sow, nor reap, nor gather crops into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more important than they? And which of you by worrying can add a single day to his life’s span? And why are you worried about clothing? Notice how the lilies of the field grow; they do not labor nor do they spin thread for cloth, yet I say to you that not even Solomon in all his glory clothed himself like one of these. But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you? You of little faith! Do not worry then, saying, ‘What are we to eat?’ or ‘What are we to drink?’ or ‘What are we to wear for clothing?’ For the Gentiles eagerly seek all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things. But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be provided to you. "So do not worry about tomorrow; for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

versions.asv: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
versions.csb: On the day I called, you answered me; you increased strength within me.,
versions.esv: On the day I called, you answered me; my strength of soul you increased.
versions.kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
versions.nasb: On the day I called, You answered me; You made me bold with strength in my soul.
versions.niv: When I called, you answered me; you greatly emboldened me.
versions.nkjv: In the day when I cried out, You answered me, And made me bold with strength in my soul.
versions.web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

versions.asv: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
versions.csb: A hot-tempered person stirs up conflict, but one slow to anger calms strife.
versions.esv: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger quiets contention.
versions.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
versions.nasb: A hot-tempered person stirs up strife, But the slow to anger calms a dispute.
versions.niv: A hot-tempered person stirs up conflict, but the one who is patient calms a quarrel.
versions.nkjv: A wrathful man stirs up strife, But hewhois slow to anger allays contention.
versions.web: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

versions.asv: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake shall find it.
versions.csb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of me will find it.
versions.esv: For whoever would save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.
versions.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
versions.nasb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
versions.niv: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it.
versions.nkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
versions.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

versions.asv: because if thou shalt confess with thy mouth Jesus as Lord, and shalt believe in thy heart that God raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved: for with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
versions.csb: If you confess with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. One believes with the heart, resulting in righteousness, and one confesses with the mouth, resulting in salvation.
versions.esv: because, if you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved.
versions.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved. For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
versions.nasb: that if you confess with your mouth Jesus as Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved; for with the heart a person believes, resulting in righteousness, and with the mouth he confesses, resulting in salvation.
versions.niv: If you declare with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved.
versions.nkjv: that if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
versions.web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

versions.asv: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
versions.csb: Brothers and sisters, if someone is overtaken in any wrongdoing, you who are spiritual, restore such a person with a gentle spirit,, watching out for yourselves so that you also won’t be tempted.
versions.esv: Brothers, if anyone is caught in any transgression, you who are spiritual should restore him in a spirit of gentleness. Keep watch on yourself, lest you too be tempted.
versions.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
versions.nasb: Brothers and sisters, even if a person is caught in any wrongdoing, you who are spiritual are to restore such a person in a spirit of gentleness; each one looking to yourself, so that you are not tempted as well.
versions.niv: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should restore that person gently. But watch yourselves, or you also may be tempted.
versions.nkjv: Brethren, if a man is overtaken in any trespass, you who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, considering yourself lest you also be tempted.
versions.web: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’ t tempted.

versions.asv: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.
versions.csb: The one who follows instruction is on the path to life, but the one who rejects correction goes astray.
versions.esv: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who rejects reproof leads others astray.
versions.kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
versions.nasb: One who is on the path of life follows instruction, But one who ignores a rebuke goes astray.
versions.niv: Whoever heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.
versions.nkjv: He who keeps instruction isin the way of life, But he who refuses correction goes astray.
versions.web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

versions.asv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
versions.csb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt should lose its taste, how can it be made salty? It’s no longer good for anything but to be thrown out and trampled under people’s feet.
versions.esv: You are the salt of the earth, but if salt has lost its taste, how shall its saltiness be restored? It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trampled under people’s feet.
versions.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
versions.nasb: You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt has become tasteless, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by people.
versions.niv: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot.
versions.nkjv: You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt loses its flavor, how shall it be seasoned? It is then good for nothing but to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by men.
versions.web: You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

versions.asv: for we brought nothing into the world, for neither can we carry anything out;
versions.csb: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out.
versions.esv: for we brought nothing into the world, and we cannot take anything out of the world.
versions.kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
versions.nasb: For we have brought nothing into the world, so we cannot take anything out of it, either.
versions.niv: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.
versions.nkjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
versions.web: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can ’ t carry anything out.

versions.asv: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
versions.csb: Know that the Lord your God is God, the faithful God who keeps his gracious covenant loyalty for a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commands.
versions.esv: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and steadfast love with those who love him and keep his commandments, to a thousand generations,
versions.kjv: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
versions.nasb: Know therefore that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God, who keeps His covenant and His faithfulness to a thousand generations for those who love Him and keep His commandments;
versions.niv: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments.
versions.nkjv: Therefore know that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations with those who love Him and keep His commandments;
versions.web: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

versions.asv: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.
versions.csb: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with salvation.
versions.esv: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with salvation.
versions.kjv: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
versions.nasb: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people; He will glorify the lowly with salvation.
versions.niv: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.
versions.nkjv: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the humble with salvation.
versions.web: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

versions.asv: because to you it hath been granted in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer in his behalf:
versions.csb: For it has been granted to you on Christ’s behalf not only to believe in him, but also to suffer for him,
versions.esv: For it has been granted to you that for the sake of Christ you should not only believe in him but also suffer for his sake,
versions.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
versions.nasb: For to you it has been granted for Christ’s sake, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer on His behalf,
versions.niv: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in him, but also to suffer for him,
versions.nkjv: For to you it has been granted on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for His sake,
versions.web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

versions.asv: For thus said the Lord Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. And ye would not:
versions.csb: For the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, has said: "You will be delivered by returning and resting; your strength will lie in quiet confidence. But you are not willing.
versions.esv: For thus said the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, "In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and in trust shall be your strength." But you were unwilling,
versions.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
versions.nasb: For this is what the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, has said: "In repentance and rest you will be saved, In quietness and trust is your strength." But you were not willing,
versions.niv: This is what the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One of Israel, says: "In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength, but you would have none of it.
versions.nkjv: For thus says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel: "In returning and rest you shall be saved; In quietness and confidence shall be your strength." But you would not,
versions.web: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, "You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence." You refused,

versions.asv: to whom God was pleased to make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
versions.csb: God wanted to make known among the Gentiles the glorious wealth of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
versions.esv: To them God chose to make known how great among the Gentiles are the riches of the glory of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
versions.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
versions.nasb: to whom God willed to make known what the wealth of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles is, the mystery that is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
versions.niv: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
versions.nkjv: To them God willed to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles: which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
versions.web: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

versions.asv: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
versions.csb: Look, I have inscribed you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.
versions.esv: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.
versions.kjv: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
versions.nasb: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; Your walls are continually before Me.
versions.niv: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.
versions.nkjv: See, I have inscribed you on the palms ofMyhands; Your walls are continually before Me.
versions.web: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.

versions.asv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
versions.csb: Better the poor person who lives with integrity than the rich one who distorts right and wrong.,
versions.esv: Better is a poor man who walks in his integrity than a rich man who is crooked in his ways.
versions.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
versions.nasb: Better is a poor person who walks in his integrity, Than a person who is crooked, though he is rich.
versions.niv: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than the rich whose ways are perverse.
versions.nkjv: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than one perverse inhis ways, though he be rich.
versions.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

versions.asv: so shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
versions.csb: so my word that comes from my mouth will not return to me empty, but it will accomplish what I please and will prosper in what I send it to do.
versions.esv: so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and shall succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
versions.kjv: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
versions.nasb: So will My word be which goes out of My mouth; It will not return to Me empty, Without accomplishing what I desire, And without succeeding in the purpose for which I sent it.
versions.niv: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.
versions.nkjv: So shall My word be that goes forth from My mouth; It shall not return to Me void, But it shall accomplish what I please, And it shall prosper inthething for which I sent it.
versions.web: so is my word that goes out of my mouth : it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

versions.asv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.
versions.csb: Wealth obtained by fraud will dwindle, but whoever earns it through labor will multiply it.
versions.esv: Wealth gained hastily will dwindle, but whoever gathers little by little will increase it.
versions.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
versions.nasb: Wealth obtained from nothing dwindles, But one who gathers by labor increases it.
versions.niv: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.
versions.nkjv: Wealth gainedby dishonesty will be diminished, But he who gathers by labor will increase.
versions.web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

versions.asv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
versions.csb: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.
versions.esv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.
versions.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
versions.nasb: For whoever does the will of My Father who is in heaven, he is My brother, and sister, and mother.
versions.niv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.
versions.nkjv: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.
versions.web: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.

versions.asv: She is more precious than rubies: And none of the things thou canst desire are to be compared unto her.
versions.csb: She is more precious than jewels; nothing you desire can equal her.
versions.esv: She is more precious than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
versions.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
versions.nasb: She is more precious than jewels, And nothing you desire compares with her.
versions.niv: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
versions.nkjv: She is more precious than rubies, And all the things you may desire cannot compare with her.
versions.web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

versions.asv: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.
versions.csb: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God’s will, than for doing evil.
versions.esv: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God’s will, than for doing evil.
versions.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
versions.nasb: For it is better, if God should will it so, that you suffer for doing what is right rather than for doing what is wrong.
versions.niv: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
versions.nkjv: For itis better, if it is the will of God, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
versions.web: For it is better, if it is God ’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

versions.asv: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness; and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.
versions.csb: And not only that, but we also boast in our afflictions, because we know that affliction produces endurance, endurance produces proven character, and proven character produces hope. This hope will not disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
versions.esv: Not only that, but we rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces endurance, and endurance produces character, and character produces hope, and hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who has been given to us.
versions.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; And patience, experience; and experience, hope: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
versions.nasb: And not only this, but we also celebrate in our tribulations, knowing that tribulation brings about perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope; and hope does not disappoint, because the love of God has been poured out within our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
versions.niv: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope. And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.
versions.nkjv: And not only that, but we also glory in tribulations, knowing that tribulation produces perseverance; and perseverance, character; and character, hope. Now hope does not disappoint, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts by the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
versions.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance ; and perseverance, proven character ; and proven character, hope ; and hope doesn’ t disappoint us, because God ’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

versions.asv: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.
versions.csb: There is no one holy like the Lord. There is no one besides you! And there is no rock like our God.
versions.esv: There is none holy like the Lord : for there is none besides you; there is no rock like our God.
versions.kjv: There is none holy as the LORD : for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
versions.nasb: There is no one holy like the Lord, Indeed, there is no one besides You, Nor is there any rock like our God.
versions.niv: There is no one holy like the Lord ; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
versions.nkjv: No one is holy like the Lord, For thereis none besides You, Nor isthere any rock like our God.
versions.web: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

versions.asv: Wherefore, even as the Holy Spirit saith, To-day if ye shall hear his voice,
versions.csb: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: Today, if you hear his voice,
versions.esv: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, "Today, if you hear his voice,
versions.kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
versions.nasb: Therefore, just as the Holy Spirit says, "Today if you hear His voice,
versions.niv: So, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you hear his voice,
versions.nkjv: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you will hear His voice,
versions.web: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, "Today if you will hear his voice,

versions.asv: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the canker-worm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer-worm, my great army which I sent among you.
versions.csb: I will repay you for the years that the swarming locust ate, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust — my great army that I sent against you.
versions.esv: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the hopper, the destroyer, and the cutter, my great army, which I sent among you.
versions.kjv: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
versions.nasb: Then I will compensate you for the years That the swarming locust has eaten, The creeping locust, the stripping locust, and the gnawing locust— My great army which I sent among you.
versions.niv: I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten— the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm — my great army that I sent among you.
versions.nkjv: So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, The crawling locust, The consuming locust, And the chewing locust, My great army which I sent among you.
versions.web: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.

versions.asv: casting down imaginations, and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;
versions.csb: and every proud thing that is raised up against the knowledge of God, and we take every thought captive to obey Christ.
versions.esv: We destroy arguments and every lofty opinion raised against the knowledge of God, and take every thought captive to obey Christ,
versions.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
versions.nasb: We are destroying arguments and all arrogance raised against the knowledge of God, and we are taking every thought captive to the obedience of Christ,
versions.niv: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
versions.nkjv: casting down arguments and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
versions.web: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

versions.asv: And if I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
versions.csb: If I have the gift of prophecy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so that I can move mountains but do not have love, I am nothing.
versions.esv: And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
versions.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
versions.nasb: If I have the gift of prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
versions.niv: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
versions.nkjv: And though I have thegiftof prophecy, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
versions.web: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’ t have love, I am nothing.

versions.asv: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are open unto their cry.
versions.csb: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry for help.
versions.esv: The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous and his ears toward their cry.
versions.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
versions.nasb: The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, And His ears are toward their cry for help.
versions.niv: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are attentive to their cry;
versions.nkjv: The eyes of the Lordare on the righteous, And His ears areopen to their cry.
versions.web: Yahweh ’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

versions.asv: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.
versions.csb: Those who look to him are radiant with joy; their faces will never be ashamed.
versions.esv: Those who look to him are radiant, and their faces shall never be ashamed.
versions.kjv: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
versions.nasb: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces will never be ashamed.
versions.niv: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.
versions.nkjv: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.
