versions.kjv: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
versions.nasb: Now then, Lord God, You are God, and Your words are truth; and You have promised this good thing to Your servant.
versions.niv: Sovereign Lord, you are God! Your covenant is trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.
versions.nkjv: And now, O Lord God, You are God, and Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
versions.web: Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

versions.asv: that the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
versions.csb: so that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
versions.esv: that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
versions.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
versions.nasb: so that the man or woman of God may be fully capable, equipped for every good work.
versions.niv: so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.
versions.nkjv: that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
versions.web: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

versions.asv: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
versions.csb: Again I saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, or the battle to the strong, or bread to the wise, or riches to the discerning, or favor to the skillful; rather, time and chance happen to all of them.
versions.esv: Again I saw that under the sun the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor bread to the wise, nor riches to the intelligent, nor favor to those with knowledge, but time and chance happen to them all.
versions.kjv: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
versions.nasb: I again saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift and the battle is not to the warriors, and neither is bread to the wise nor wealth to the discerning, nor favor to the skillful; for time and chance overtake them all.
versions.niv: I have seen something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift or the battle to the strong, nor does food come to the wise or wealth to the brilliant or favor to the learned; but time and chance happen to them all.
versions.nkjv: I returned and saw under the sun that— The race is not to the swift, Nor the battle to the strong, Nor bread to the wise, Nor riches to men of understanding, Nor favor to men of skill; But time and chance happen to them all.
versions.web: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill ; but time and chance happen to them all.

versions.asv: And there is no creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
versions.csb: No creature is hidden from him, but all things are naked and exposed to the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
versions.esv: And no creature is hidden from his sight, but all are naked and exposed to the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
versions.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
versions.nasb: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are open and laid bare to the eyes of Him to whom we must answer.
versions.niv: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
versions.nkjv: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are naked and open to the eyes of Him to whom we mustgive account.
versions.web: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

versions.asv: yet, looking unto the promise of God, he wavered not through unbelief, but waxed strong through faith, giving glory to God,
versions.csb: He did not waver in unbelief at God’s promise but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
versions.esv: No unbelief made him waver concerning the promise of God, but he grew strong in his faith as he gave glory to God,
versions.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
versions.nasb: yet, with respect to the promise of God, he did not waver in unbelief but grew strong in faith, giving glory to God,
versions.niv: Yet he did not waver through unbelief regarding the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
versions.nkjv: He did not waver at the promise of God through unbelief, but was strengthened in faith, giving glory to God,
versions.web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’ t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

versions.asv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And he that heareth, let him say, Come. And he that is athirst, let him come: he that will, let him take the water of life freely.
versions.csb: Both the Spirit and the bride say, "Come! "Let anyone who hears, say, "Come! "Let the one who is thirsty come. Let the one who desires take the water of life freely.
versions.esv: The Spirit and the Bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires take the water of life without price.
versions.kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
versions.nasb: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires, take the water of life without cost.
versions.niv: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let the one who hears say, "Come!" Let the one who is thirsty come; and let the one who wishes take the free gift of the water of life.
versions.nkjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let him who hears say, "Come!" And let him who thirsts come. Whoever desires, let him take the water of life freely.
versions.web: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come !" He who hears, let him say, "Come !" He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

versions.asv: Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
versions.csb: Come to me, all of you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, because I am lowly and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.esv: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
versions.nasb: Come to Me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.niv: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.nkjv: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
versions.web: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart ; and you will find rest for your souls.

versions.asv: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be made for all men; for kings and all that are in high place; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and gravity.
versions.csb: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for everyone, for kings and all those who are in authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
versions.esv: First of all, then, I urge that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all people, for kings and all who are in high positions, that we may lead a peaceful and quiet life, godly and dignified in every way.
versions.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men; For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
versions.nasb: First of all, then, I urge that requests, prayers, intercession, and thanksgiving be made in behalf of all people, for kings and all who are in authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
versions.niv: I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people— for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.
versions.nkjv: Therefore I exhort first of all that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks be made for all men, for kings and all who are in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.
versions.web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men, for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

versions.asv: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
versions.csb: Caesar’s," they said to him. Then he said to them, "Give, then, to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.
versions.esv: They said, "Caesar’s." Then he said to them, "Therefore render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.
versions.kjv: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
versions.nasb: They *said to Him, "Caesar’s." Then He *said to them, "Then pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s; and to God the things that are God’s.
versions.niv: Caesar’s," they replied. Then he said to them, "So give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.
versions.nkjv: They said to Him, "Caesar’s." And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.
versions.web: They said to him, "Caesar ’s." Then he said to them, "Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar ’s, and to God the things that are God ’s.

versions.asv: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.
versions.csb: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, he got up, went out, and made his way to a deserted place; and there he was praying.
versions.esv: And rising very early in the morning, while it was still dark, he departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed.
versions.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
versions.nasb: And in the early morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house, and went away to a secluded place, and prayed there for a time.
versions.niv: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.
versions.nkjv: Now in the morning, having risen a long while before daylight, He went out and departed to a solitary place; and there He prayed.
versions.web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

versions.asv: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
versions.csb: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power, and authority before all time, now and forever. Amen.
versions.esv: to the only God, our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and forever. Amen.
versions.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
versions.nasb: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority before all time and now and forever. Amen.
versions.niv: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.
versions.nkjv: To God our Savior, Who alone is wise, Be glory and majesty, Dominion and power, Both now and forever. Amen.
versions.web: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

versions.asv: and he made of one every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, having determined their appointed seasons, and the bounds of their habitation;
versions.csb: From one man he has made every nationality to live over the whole earth and has determined their appointed times and the boundaries of where they live.
versions.esv: And he made from one man every nation of mankind to live on all the face of the earth, having determined allotted periods and the boundaries of their dwelling place,
versions.kjv: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
versions.nasb: and He made from one man every nation of mankind to live on all the face of the earth, having determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their habitation,
versions.niv: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.
versions.nkjv: And He has made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined their preappointed times and the boundaries of their dwellings,
versions.web: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

versions.asv: But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
versions.csb: But seek first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness, and all these things will be provided for you. Therefore don’t worry about tomorrow, because tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
versions.esv: But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you. "Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble.
versions.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
versions.nasb: But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be provided to you. "So do not worry about tomorrow; for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
versions.niv: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well. Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
versions.nkjv: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things shall be added to you. Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about its own things. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble.
versions.web: But seek first God ’s Kingdom and his righteousness ; and all these things will be given to you as well. Therefore don’ t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day ’s own evil is sufficient.

versions.asv: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.
versions.csb: The one who searches for what is good seeks favor, but if someone looks for trouble, it will come to him.
versions.esv: Whoever diligently seeks good seeks favor, but evil comes to him who searches for it.
versions.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
versions.nasb: One who diligently seeks good seeks favor, But one who seeks evil, evil will come to him.
versions.niv: Whoever seeks good finds favor, but evil comes to one who searches for it.
versions.nkjv: He who earnestly seeks good finds favor, But trouble will come to him who seeks evil.
versions.web: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

versions.asv: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
versions.csb: Lord, I call to you; my rock, do not be deaf to me. If you remain silent to me, I will be like those going down to the Pit.
versions.esv: To you, O Lord, I call; my rock, be not deaf to me, lest, if you be silent to me, I become like those who go down to the pit.
versions.kjv: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
versions.nasb: To You, Lord, I call; My rock, do not be deaf to me, For if You are silent to me, I will become like those who go down to the pit.
versions.niv: To you, Lord, I call; you are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.
versions.nkjv: To You I will cry, O Lord my Rock: Do not be silent to me, Lest, if You are silent to me, I become like those who go down to the pit.
versions.web: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

versions.asv: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.
versions.csb: With his mouth the ungodly destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
versions.esv: With his mouth the godless man would destroy his neighbor, but by knowledge the righteous are delivered.
versions.kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
versions.nasb: With his mouth the godless person destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be rescued.
versions.niv: With their mouths the godless destroy their neighbors, but through knowledge the righteous escape.
versions.nkjv: The hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be delivered.
versions.web: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

versions.asv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it be received with thanksgiving:
versions.csb: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
versions.esv: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
versions.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
versions.nasb: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with gratitude;
versions.niv: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
versions.nkjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be refused if it is received with thanksgiving;
versions.web: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

versions.asv: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
versions.csb: Let the whole earth shout triumphantly to the Lord !
versions.esv: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth!
versions.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
versions.nasb: Shout joyfully to the Lord, all the earth.
versions.niv: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth.
versions.nkjv: Make a joyful shout to the Lord, all you lands!
versions.web: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

versions.asv: And the tongue is a fire: the world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the wheel of nature, and is set on fire by hell.
versions.csb: And the tongue is a fire. The tongue, a world of unrighteousness, is placed among our members. It stains the whole body, sets the course of life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
versions.esv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of unrighteousness. The tongue is set among our members, staining the whole body, setting on fire the entire course of life, and set on fire by hell.
versions.kjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
versions.nasb: And the tongue is a fire, the very world of unrighteousness; the tongue is set among our body’s parts as that which defiles the whole body and sets on fire the course of our life, and is set on fire by hell.
versions.niv: The tongue also is a fire, a world of evil among the parts of the body. It corrupts the whole body, sets the whole course of one’s life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
versions.nkjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity. The tongue is so set among our members that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire by hell.
versions.web: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

versions.asv: And if I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it profiteth me nothing.
versions.csb: And if I give away all my possessions, and if I give over my body in order to boast but do not have love, I gain nothing.
versions.esv: If I give away all I have, and if I deliver up my body to be burned, but have not love, I gain nothing.
versions.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
versions.nasb: And if I give away all my possessions to charity, and if I surrender my body so that I may glory, but do not have love, it does me no good.
versions.niv: If I give all I possess to the poor and give over my body to hardship that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
versions.nkjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed thepoor, and though I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it profits me nothing.
versions.web: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’ t have love, it profits me nothing.

versions.asv: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves; for to-morrow Jehovah will do wonders among you.
versions.csb: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, because the Lord will do wonders among you tomorrow.
versions.esv: Then Joshua said to the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you.
versions.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
versions.nasb: Then Joshua said to the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do miracles among you.
versions.niv: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.
versions.nkjv: And Joshua said to the people, "Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you.
versions.web: Joshua said to the people, "Sanctify yourselves ; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.

versions.asv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
versions.csb: What then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with my understanding. I will sing praise with the spirit, and I will also sing praise with my understanding.
versions.esv: What am I to do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will pray with my mind also; I will sing praise with my spirit, but I will sing with my mind also.
versions.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
versions.nasb: What is the outcome then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will pray with the mind also; I will sing with the spirit, but I will sing with the mind also.
versions.niv: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my understanding; I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my understanding.
versions.nkjv: What is theconclusion then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with the understanding. I will sing with the spirit, and I will also sing with the understanding.
versions.web: What should I do ? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

versions.asv: Ye have heard that it was said, Thou shalt love thy neighbor, and hate thine enemy: but I say unto you, Love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you; that ye may be sons of your Father who is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sendeth rain on the just and the unjust.
versions.csb: You have heard that it was said, Love your neighbor, and hate your enemy. But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may be children of your Father in heaven. For he causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
versions.esv: You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’ But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may be sons of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
versions.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy. But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you; That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
versions.nasb: You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’ But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may prove yourselves to be sons of your Father who is in heaven; for He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
versions.niv: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’ But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, that you may be children of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
versions.nkjv: You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’ But I say to you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who spitefully use you and persecute you, that you may be sons of your Father in heaven; for He makes His sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
versions.web: You have heard that it was said, ‘ You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’ But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you, that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

versions.asv: having been buried with him in baptism, wherein ye were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
versions.csb: when you were buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
versions.esv: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the powerful working of God, who raised him from the dead.
versions.kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
versions.nasb: having been buried with Him in baptism, in which you were also raised with Him through faith in the working of God, who raised Him from the dead.

versions.niv: Whoever derides their neighbor has no sense, but the one who has understanding holds their tongue.

versions.web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

versions.asv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as becometh saints;
versions.csb: But sexual immorality and any impurity or greed should not even be heard of among you, as is proper for saints.
versions.esv: But sexual immorality and all impurity or covetousness must not even be named among you, as is proper among saints.
versions.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
versions.nasb: But sexual immorality or any impurity or greed must not even be mentioned among you, as is proper among saints;
versions.niv: But among you there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed, because these are improper for God’s holy people.
versions.nkjv: But fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as is fitting for saints;
versions.web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

versions.asv: But all things when they are reproved are made manifest by the light: for everything that is made manifest is light.
versions.csb: Everything exposed by the light is made visible,
versions.esv: But when anything is exposed by the light, it becomes visible,
versions.kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
versions.nasb: But all things become visible when they are exposed by the light, for everything that becomes visible is light.
versions.niv: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible—and everything that is illuminated becomes a light.
versions.nkjv: But all things that are exposed are made manifest by the light, for whatever makes manifest is light.
versions.web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

versions.asv: and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
versions.csb: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and then all the peoples of the earth will mourn; and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
versions.esv: Then will appear in heaven the sign of the Son of Man, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
versions.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
versions.nasb: And then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
versions.niv: Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
versions.nkjv: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
versions.web: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

versions.asv: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction which I suffer of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;
versions.csb: Be gracious to me, Lord ; consider my affliction at the hands of those who hate me. Lift me up from the gates of death,
versions.esv: Be gracious to me, O Lord ! See my affliction from those who hate me, O you who lift me up from the gates of death,
versions.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD ; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
versions.nasb: Be gracious to me, Lord; See my oppression from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
versions.niv: Lord, see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,
versions.nkjv: Have mercy on me, O Lord! Consider my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
versions.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

versions.asv: But Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffereth him.
versions.csb: Jesus answered him, "Allow it for now, because this is the way for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then John allowed him to be baptized.
versions.esv: But Jesus answered him, "Let it be so now, for thus it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he consented.
versions.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
versions.nasb: But Jesus, answering, said to him, "Allow it at this time; for in this way it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he *allowed Him.
versions.niv: Jesus replied, "Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness." Then John consented.
versions.nkjv: But Jesus answered and said to him, "Permit it to be so now, for thus it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he allowed Him.
versions.web: But Jesus, answering, said to him, "Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he allowed him.

versions.asv: Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou hast also wrought all our works for us.
versions.csb: Lord, you will establish peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
versions.esv: O Lord, you will ordain peace for us, for you have indeed done for us all our works.
versions.kjv: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
versions.nasb: Lord, You will establish peace for us, Since You have also performed for us all our works.
versions.niv: Lord, you establish peace for us; all that we have accomplished you have done for us.
versions.nkjv: Lord, You will establish peace for us, For You have also done all our works in us.
versions.web: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

versions.asv: Follow after love; yet desire earnestly spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
versions.csb: Pursue love and desire spiritual gifts, and especially that you may prophesy.
versions.esv: Pursue love, and earnestly desire the spiritual gifts, especially that you may prophesy.
versions.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
versions.nasb: Pursue love, yet earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
versions.niv: Follow the way of love and eagerly desire gifts of the Spirit, especially prophecy.
versions.nkjv: Pursue love, and desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
versions.web: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

versions.asv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
versions.csb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves the one born of him.
versions.esv: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves whoever has been born of him.
versions.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
versions.nasb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves the child born of Him.
versions.niv: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.
versions.nkjv: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves Him who begot also loves him who is begotten of Him.
versions.web: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

versions.asv: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.
versions.csb: Lord my God, you have done many things — your wondrous works and your plans for us; none can compare with you. If I were to report and speak of them, they are more than can be told.
versions.esv: You have multiplied, O Lord my God, your wondrous deeds and your thoughts toward us; none can compare with you! I will proclaim and tell of them, yet they are more than can be told.
versions.kjv: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
versions.nasb: Many, Lord my God, are the wonders which You have done, And Your thoughts toward us; There is no one to compare with You. If I would declare and speak of them, They would be too numerous to count.
versions.niv: Many, Lord my God, are the wonders you have done, the things you planned for us. None can compare with you; were I to speak and tell of your deeds, they would be too many to declare.
versions.nkjv: Many, O Lord my God, are Your wonderful works Which You have done; And Your thoughts toward us Cannot be recounted to You in order; If I would declare and speak ofthem, They are more than can be numbered.
versions.web: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can ’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

versions.asv: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that they that practise such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also consent with them that practise them.
versions.csb: Although they know God’s just sentence — that those who practice such things deserve to die, — they not only do them, but even applaud, others who practice them.
versions.esv: Though they know God’s righteous decree that those who practice such things deserve to die, they not only do them but give approval to those who practice them.
versions.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
versions.nasb: and although they know the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, they not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
versions.niv: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things deserve death, they not only continue to do these very things but also approve of those who practice them.
versions.nkjv: who, knowing the righteous judgment of God, that those who practice such things are deserving of death, not only do the same but also approve of those who practice them.
versions.web: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

versions.asv: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.
versions.csb: But the righteous are glad; they rejoice before God and celebrate with joy.
versions.esv: But the righteous shall be glad; they shall exult before God; they shall be jubilant with joy!
versions.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
versions.nasb: But the righteous will be joyful; they will rejoice before God; Yes, they will rejoice with gladness.
versions.niv: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.
versions.nkjv: But let the righteous be glad; Let them rejoice before God; Yes, let them rejoice exceedingly.
versions.web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

versions.asv: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
versions.csb: Provide justice for the needy and the fatherless; uphold the rights of the oppressed and the destitute.
versions.esv: Give justice to the weak and the fatherless; maintain the right of the afflicted and the destitute.
versions.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
versions.nasb: Vindicate the weak and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
versions.niv: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.
versions.nkjv: Defend the poor and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and needy.
versions.web: Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

versions.asv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?
versions.csb: The life of every living thing is in his hand, as well as the breath of all humanity.
versions.esv: In his hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all mankind.
versions.kjv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
versions.nasb: In whose hand is the life of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?
versions.niv: In his hand is the life of every creature and the breath of all mankind.
versions.nkjv: In whose hand is the life of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?
versions.web: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind ?

versions.asv: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s shall save it.
versions.csb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of me and the gospel will save it.
versions.esv: For whoever would save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake and the gospel’s will save it.
versions.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
versions.nasb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and the gospel’s will save it.
versions.niv: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.
versions.nkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and the gospel’s will save it.
versions.web: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it ; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

versions.asv: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers; But a prudent wife is from Jehovah.
versions.csb: A house and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the Lord.
versions.esv: House and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the Lord.
versions.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
versions.nasb: House and wealth are an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife is from the Lord.
versions.niv: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the Lord.
versions.nkjv: Houses and riches are an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife is from the Lord.
versions.web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

versions.asv: The Spirit of the Lord Jehovah is upon me; because Jehovah hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound; to proclaim the year of Jehovah’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn; to appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Jehovah, that he may be glorified.
versions.csb: The Spirit of the Lord God is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners; to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor, and the day of our God’s vengeance; to comfort all who mourn, to provide for those who mourn in Zion; to give them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, festive oil instead of mourning, and splendid clothes instead of despair. And they will be called righteous trees, planted by the Lord to glorify him.
versions.esv: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me to bring good news to the poor; he has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to those who are bound; to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn; to grant to those who mourn in Zion— to give them a beautiful headdress instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of a faint spirit; that they may be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he may be glorified.
versions.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound; To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn; To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
versions.nasb: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me, Because the Lord anointed me To bring good news to the humble; He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, To proclaim release to captives And freedom to prisoners; To proclaim the favorable year of the Lord And the day of vengeance of our God; To comfort all who mourn, To grant those who mourn in Zion, Giving them a garland instead of ashes, The oil of gladness instead of mourning, The cloak of praise instead of a disheartened spirit. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, The planting of the Lord, that He may be glorified.
versions.niv: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners, to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn, and provide for those who grieve in Zion— to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the Lord for the display of his splendor.
versions.nkjv: The Spirit of the Lord Godis upon Me, Because the Lord has anointed Me To preach good tidings to the poor; He has sent Me to heal the brokenhearted, To proclaim liberty to the captives, And the opening of the prison to thosewhoare bound; To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, And the day of vengeance of our God; To comfort all who mourn, To console those who mourn in Zion, To give them beauty for ashes, The oil of joy for mourning, The garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; That they may be called trees of righteousness, The planting of the Lord, that He may be glorified.
versions.web: The Lord Yahweh ’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound, to proclaim the year of Yahweh ’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn, to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.

versions.asv: and put on the new man, that after God hath been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
versions.csb: and to put on, the new self, the one created according to God’s likeness in righteousness and purity of the truth.
versions.esv: and to put on the new self, created after the likeness of God in true righteousness and holiness.
versions.kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
versions.nasb: and to put on the new self, which in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of the truth.
versions.niv: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
versions.nkjv: and that you put on the new man which was created according to God, in true righteousness and holiness.
versions.web: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

versions.asv: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
versions.csb: knowing that whatever good each one does, slave or free, he will receive this back from the Lord.
versions.esv: knowing that whatever good anyone does, this he will receive back from the Lord, whether he is a bondservant or is free.
versions.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
versions.nasb: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive this back from the Lord, whether slave or free.
versions.niv: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good they do, whether they are slave or free.
versions.nkjv: knowing that whatever good anyone does, he will receive the same from the Lord, whether heis a slave or free.
versions.web: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

versions.asv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
versions.csb: God, how precious your thoughts are to me; how vast their sum is!
versions.esv: How precious to me are your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!
versions.kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
versions.nasb: How precious also are Your thoughts for me, God! How vast is the sum of them!
versions.niv: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!
versions.nkjv: How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
versions.web: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum !

versions.asv: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:
versions.csb: Older men are to be self-controlled, worthy of respect, sensible, and sound in faith, love, and endurance.
versions.esv: Older men are to be sober-minded, dignified, self-controlled, sound in faith, in love, and in steadfastness.
versions.kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
versions.nasb: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, sound in faith, in love, in perseverance.
versions.niv: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.
versions.nkjv: that the older men be sober, reverent, temperate, sound in faith, in love, in patience;
versions.web: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

versions.asv: but even as we have been approved of God to be intrusted with the gospel, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God who proveth our hearts.
versions.csb: Instead, just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please people, but rather God, who examines our hearts.
versions.esv: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please man, but to please God who tests our hearts.
versions.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
versions.nasb: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not intending to please people, but to please God, who examines our hearts.
versions.niv: On the contrary, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please people but God, who tests our hearts.
versions.nkjv: But as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, even so we speak, not as pleasing men, but God who tests our hearts.
versions.web: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak — not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

versions.asv: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.
versions.csb: strengthening the disciples by encouraging them to continue in the faith and by telling them, "It is necessary to go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God.
versions.esv: strengthening the souls of the disciples, encouraging them to continue in the faith, and saying that through many tribulations we must enter the kingdom of God.
versions.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
versions.nasb: strengthening the souls of the disciples, encouraging them to continue in the faith, and saying, "It is through many tribulations that we must enter the kingdom of God.
versions.niv: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God," they said.
versions.nkjv: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and saying, "We must through many tribulations enter the kingdom of God.
versions.web: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God ’s Kingdom.

versions.asv: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
versions.csb: There is life in the path of righteousness, and in its path there is no death.,
versions.esv: In the path of righteousness is life, and in its pathway there is no death.
versions.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
versions.nasb: In the way of righteousness there is life, And in its pathway there is no death.
versions.niv: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.
versions.nkjv: In the way of righteousness is life, And in its pathway thereis no death.
versions.web: In the way of righteousness is life ; in its path there is no death.

versions.asv: for the Holy Spirit shall teach you in that very hour what ye ought to say.
versions.csb: For the Holy Spirit will teach you at that very hour what must be said.
versions.esv: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say.
versions.kjv: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
versions.nasb: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say.
versions.niv: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.
versions.nkjv: For the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say.
versions.web: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.

versions.asv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.
versions.esv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
versions.kjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
versions.nasb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.
versions.niv: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
versions.nkjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
versions.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
